title: Azusawa Kohane — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, are you free this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This weekend? Um, I am meeting with someone from another school on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Then do you wanna go to Phoenix Wonderland together on Sunday?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
My mom received a pair of tickets from a friend, you see!
So she asked me to go enjoy myself with another friend.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry, maybe you don't like theme parks?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What? N-Not at all! I like theme parks, and PXL...
I mean, Phoenix Wonderland is a place that I really love to visit!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It always feels so homey.
Going there cheers me up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They've added some new attractions recently, but the nostalgic mood hasn't gone away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They have a lot of fun and playful areas to go to besides the attractions too. And all the cast members of the park are super nice, too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, if you go during your birthday, they have a special...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh! I-I'm sorry.
I must be talking too much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, I've never seen you talk so fast before, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You really love that theme park, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes. But it's a little childish, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No way! I love visiting the place too, and I'm pretty sure plenty of grown-ups do as well!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If we're going, we should definitely try out all the different attractions they have available!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, i-if you'd like, I can come up with a route for that day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Dad and I often visit the park together, so I know of a few shortcuts...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Looks like I've found the most reliable companion for this! Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay. I'll try to think of something nice. Oh, but...
Are you really sure you want to go with me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, you mentioned that you've finally been able to talk to Kiritani lately, and she's your idol, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be better to invite her instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, when Mom gave me the tickets, I immediately thought of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! That's why I wanted to invite you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Besides, you were the first friend I made in high school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd love to go with Haruka one day, too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've already decided that you're the one I wanted to invite first this time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You were also the first friend I made in high school...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I'm really happy that you asked me to join you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sunday just can't come soon enough!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, are there any attractions that we absolutely shouldn't miss in this park?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, it's not really an attraction, but we should definitely visit the recently revived Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes!
Oh, it may take a while for me to explain...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! We still have lots of time before lunch is over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So what sort of performances are being shown there?
You know, on that...err, wonder place?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. The Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The actors there are high school students like us!
They come up with the stage productions and effects themselves, and...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bad news, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! Wh-What's wrong, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Class B just had math, and I heard the teacher
gave them a pop quiz!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A pop quiz? Oh, I get it. Our next class is math too, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Th-This can only mean...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's the same teacher. We'll probably get the pop quiz too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh, this is really bad!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It doesn't help that we know there's a quiz coming, because we don't know which part to study for!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Are you weak in math, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um, I'm barely average, I think?
Formulas and such just can't seem to stay in my head.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whereas you're terrific with practically every subject!
I'm so envious...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm better with my studies than physical activities because I can study at my own pace, but that's about all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ugh... Being able to say you're better with studies is amazing enough in itself... Wait, this is no time to be jealous! What should I do about the pop quiz?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, about that. The teacher kept saying the formula being taught in the last lesson was something very important. I think it's highly likely we'll be quizzed on that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So... Ah, here it is.
I think you'll do fine as long as you revise the formula found on this page.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll do my utter best to review it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay. If you need any help, just let me know.
I think I should be able to teach you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane! You just saved my life!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-That's over the top...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho!
Now's not the time to be leisurely buying juice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's happening?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We may be having a pop quiz in our math class later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These questions are likely to appear, so please review them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
But why are you telling me all this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah! She left... Oh dear...
It's still a little hard for me to talk to her properly.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I really hope we can get to know her better one day. After all, we're in the same class...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, maybe if we look out for more opportunities?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're right. But there's no need to rush.
First of all, we have to overcome our upcoming pop quiz.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup. Okay, let me run through the first question...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um, Kohane?
Did we learn this last week?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I write down lesson dates on the textbook and in my notes, so we definitely did.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, so if I look through my own notes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see, the last page...wait. What's this?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Clothing...design?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I remember now. The idea for this really cute outfit came to me that day, and...I didn't take any notes at all...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori, would you like to see my notes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ko...Kohane! My savior!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The teacher really did give us a pop quiz.
Thankfully, we predicted the questions quite accurately.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! And if you hadn't shared that with me, I probably would've gotten every single question wrong...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, you didn't just predict the questions correctly. You even taught me how to solve them! I managed to solve all five questions!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, that's great.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What's the matter, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! Um...you're most...welcome?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I haven't said anything, yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But, well...yeah. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! Because you told her about the quiz, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I think that must have been it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really hope I can get to know Hinomori better, too!)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And then you substitute x here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, I think I got it. Like this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's easy from here... Solved!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew! I finally understand how this works.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well done, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you for explaining it to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. Going through these problems with her was a good review for me, and it made me happy to help An.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What would I do without you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've got to do okay on the next exam, or the teacher will make me stay after school for extra tutoring.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure it's okay for us to study here, though? You're not open for business yet, but it still feels strange having the cafe all to ourselves.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's better here.
I'd only get distracted at home.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Besides... Wait here a minute.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She went to the kitchen? Is she getting us some food?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Teacup, check. Now, the tea leaves...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you by any chance making tea?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. You've earned yourself a treat!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And don't worry, I got dad's permission to use the cafe stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks. Can I help you with anything?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nope. Just wait and relax. I want to do something nice for you in return for you teaching me math.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, okay then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll have to be patient, though. I need to warm up the crockery first, or it won't taste as good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, I remember hearing that getting the right temperature makes a big difference for black tea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's true! Also you should let it infuse for the right amount of time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad taught me all about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By now, I'm pretty confident I can make great-tasting tea for the customers, so that's one more skill besides singing that I can be proud of.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, it's ready.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, it has a beautiful color.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It tastes amazing, too. Come on, try it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mmm, it's delicious!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Told you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's nice to have special skills like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've got talents of your own. Like singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And being able to undertake any task with absolute commitment. That's a skill in my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm, I guess photography would count too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Photography?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Just like your dad taught you about specialty teas, mine taught me photography.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He's very picky about the photos he takes and has a whole assortment of cameras and lenses.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I turned 12, he gave me one of his cameras and showed me how to use it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, that's cool. How do you learn to take better pics? Do you take photos of landscapes or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I also go to Phoenix Wonderland to take pictures. I can spend the whole day there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A whole day? Do you split that between photography and having fun with the park attractions?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What, no. If I'm going to shoot photos, that's the only thing I do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sometimes I also have Count Pearl pose for me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Count Pearl's—that's your dad's pet snake, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good to know I'm not the only one with a weird dad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, yeah.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So we've got another thing in common—we've been taught special skills by our dads!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, and by the way, I'd love to see some of your photos!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I'll bring some to show you next time.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, as promised, I brought photos to show you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Photos you took?
Sweet! Show me, show me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure. So, these are just some of the better ones...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we've got customers! Meh, it's just you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why do you assume we're not customers?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hi. What have you got there?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just showing An some of the photos I took.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, well. You even have them neatly organized in an album. Or even two albums, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that one's something else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Is this you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... When I told my dad that you wanted to see my photographs, he insisted that I also show you these...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your old man wants to show off his camera skills too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not his camera skills, but his cute daughter.
Look, most of these are close-ups of Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What the heck's this?
You've got a snake around your neck?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is Count Pearl.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Count Pearl? What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We got her when I was a toddler.
We grew up together, so she's like my scaly sister.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It sounds like you must be close.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Humans and snakes can't be siblings, dude.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sheesh, chill. It's just what people say, that pets are members of the family.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Who looks after the snake?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Both Dad and I.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still have much to learn from him, both about photography and snake care.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How about you, boys? Did your dads teach you anything cool?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm... Anything cool, huh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My dad taught me to play the piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't play anymore, but my two brothers do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, you've got two brothers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's so nice when the whole family shares an interest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Painting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
My dad's a painter.
I didn't stick with it long, it was too boring.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, so your dad's an artist.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait a minute... Shinonome...
Is your dad THAT Shinonome?! He's famous!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I thought I heard the name somewhere before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya's dad's more of a celebrity than mine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What am I doing...? I didn't need to bring that up.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm happy I learned something new about you and your families!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you take the photos in this album, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? Dude, it's clear these are hers.
See how they're mostly out of focus?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ouch!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oops, sorry! I didn't notice you had your foot there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're so violent...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Moving on... Which of these photos would you say is your best, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Let me think... Maybe this one.
This is Count Pearl enjoying her meal!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's amazing. You can make out the shape of the prey she's just swallowed passing through her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't want to see that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. She's such a glutton. She had two mice in her mouth.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yet she still wanted more! She was so cute with her mouth stuffed full like a sock puppet, that I just had to take a picture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's weird how you're not squeamish about things like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I actually brought one more album with only Count Pearl's photos. Check it out!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here, hot milk for you, Kohane and An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll serve yours soon, Miku and Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... MEIKO? Why do you keep looking at me? Is there something on my face?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No. It's just that you've changed so much.
You've cut off quite a lot of your hair, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe... Yes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's so true. I was really taken aback when I first saw you in your new hairdo too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was the hairdresser surprised when you asked to have so much hair cut off?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No. I didn't go to a hairdressing salon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then where?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, well... I cut it myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No way?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You did it yourself?!
Like how?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um... I just took out a pair of scissors from the drawer and...snipped it off like this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Snipped it off?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I-Is it really that shocking?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Of course it is!
You used a regular pair of scissors, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Weren't you afraid of hurting yourself while cutting?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well... I just had the impulse to do it at that moment. It just felt like it was something I had to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You're so gutsy for the strangest things sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that shows just how determined you were.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! Yes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Those clothes look good on you, too.
Do you wear them for your performances?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, yes. I actually bought them for that purpose...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I seldom wear clothes like this, though. I probably don't look very nice in them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't be silly, Kohane! You look great in them!
That haircut helps to bring your image closer to their style, too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, I think she's right.
You look good in those clothes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had such a hard time deciding what clothes to get before finally deciding on these...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I'm really happy that you both like them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad I didn't perform in my school uniform!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does that mean...if you hadn't bought those clothes, you would've gone for events in your uniform?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Ah, well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was what I intended to do if I couldn't find anything nice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank goodness you found something, then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... A school uniform would be way too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-Is it really that weird?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More like it's just gonna make you really stand out?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it can be a pretty cool thing to try, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's true... Appearing in a school uniform and causing a bit of buzz, then launching into our song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that actually sounds like a plan!
Wanna try it out for our next show?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! N-No, it's going to be too embarrassing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, you were ready to perform in uniform to begin with, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just like that thing with your haircut, you really are a gutsy one, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, it certainly does feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm really not sure...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: G-Good afternoon...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have a seat at that empty table over there. Will iced tea work for you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome and Aoyagi are not here yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. You're the first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I think they should be here soon, though.
Probably just being delayed by homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, welcome!
Take a seat there, I'll bring you a drink...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, where's Akito?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He received a phone call just before I walked in. He's talking on the phone outside now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's probably about...that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yo.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Your seat's over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hello, Shinonome.
How was your phone call?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, well, since we're all here, I should let everyone know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember the time I mentioned we may be invited to a huge event? I just received an official invitation just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...
We only just started performing as a group not too long ago...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito knows a lot of people. He often gets invitations to such events. I think he knows the organizer for the event this time as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's the event about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's a gathering of new artists based in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here's the list of currently confirmed performers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess I shouldn't be surprised to see so many talented rookie groups on the list for such a large event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was really nervous about the event being so big, but I'm relieved to hear it's for rookies only.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One more thing, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're the special guests of this event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nicely done, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That means...we're the highlight of the event, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um... Shinonome?
Aren't we considered rookies too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya and I have been performing since middle school.
We're not rookies.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And she's pretty well-known as well just for being Ken's daughter.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They've all performed in many events before...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I can count the number of times I've performed on a stage with two hands...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm not good enough to be a special guest...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you nervous, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Ah, I'm sorry...
I'm just not sure...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha, don't worry!
You'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I hope so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's right. You have what it takes, so don't be unsure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, Aoyagi...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I felt uneasy because I'm the only one without much experience.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if you think I'll be fine, then I guess it's okay for me to have a little more confidence in myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just so we're clear, I didn't sign up for the event without thinking because it's big and we're special guests.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't have accepted the invite if I didn't feel like we were up to the task. In the first place, I wouldn't team up with someone I didn't acknowledge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You catch my drift?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that that's settled, we need to think of what songs to sing! You have anything in mind, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Well, I want to...
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The biggest difference between complete novices and seasoned veterans...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...hane!
Hey, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! A-An?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I should be asking you that.
What's up? You totally zoned out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, sorry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can talk to me if there's something on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, it's about the other day... It keeps nagging at me that I'm so inexperienced compared to the rest of you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I was wondering if I could sing here at Weekend Garage sometime, you know, in front of the customers...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's a great idea! And I'd get to listen to your singing while waiting tables! You're absolutely welcome to!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew, I'm glad you're for this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, you just wait here while I go talk to my dad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Wait, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'd like to do this myself.
It really should come from me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't let you take care of everything for me, or I'll never learn.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Besides... This is going to be my solo performance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, are you working or what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oops! Sorry, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've got stuff to do. Talk to you later, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here's your milk tea.
Careful, it's hot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, Mr. Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yes?
Did you want to order something else?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, I...
I wanted to ask you a favor...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's... It's just that I...
I'm the least experienced member of my group.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I don't think it's fair that I'm holding everyone back because I'm new to this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to... Get more experience singing in public.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Please...! Would it be okay if I sang at your cafe, even if it's just one day a week?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is... Is that a no?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm not saying no, but I wanted to warn you first that since you teamed up with An, Akito and Toya, people have started paying attention to you too.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The first time you sang here, they had low expectations since you were a rookie. But that's no longer the case.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
They may expect more from you.
Are you prepared for that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I want to do it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know how everyone will react to me, but I know I have to do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is the only way forward if I'm going to stay in this group.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And that's really important to me...
So please, let me sing here!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Well then...
It seems like your mind is made up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you know, it's not just successful performances that count towards “experience”. Failing is just as important.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Failing too?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You see, everyone's afraid of failure.
Afraid of losing their fame or their team's trust.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But the worst is when you're too scared to face it and just run away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you run away from failure, that damage can't be undone and it's all over...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, but you're strong enough to confront it. Sure there's still stuff you can't do yet, but you're not all green either.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
So when you sing,
do it with confidence and pride.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I will...! Thank you so much, Mr. Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Make some space.
I've got cookies for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did I order cookies?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's on me!
Looks like the talk went well?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yup...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's a small step, but it's a step forward...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An, thank you for believing in me.)
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tch! An's been gone a while...
How long is this gonna take?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She said she's looking for the event organizer, so maybe she's having some trouble.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
She got us a special invite to this event.
She must have so many connections...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry, I was just thinking that I need to give it my best shot today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't stress out about it so much, or you'll panic and fumble again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I won't...!
I'll sing as well as you all do!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good, you're finally showing some confidence.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A crowd's starting to form around the stage...

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member A
rows.Line: Did you see? Vivid BAD SQUAD's in today's lineup.

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member B
rows.Line:
Oh, them?
I saw those guys at STAY GOLDEN.
They're nothing special.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm?!

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member A
rows.Line:
Really?
I've heard good things about them before.

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member B
rows.Line:
They just happened to catch a good wave.
I'm surprised they even got into this event.

rows.Speaker: Male Audience Member A
rows.Line: Man... I was kind of hyped to see them too. Now I'm all bummed out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tch...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'm sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, don't worry about it, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But, it's my fault...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Look, there's always gonna be haters.
Don't let them get to you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... If I didn't mess up at STAY GOLDEN, our rep wouldn't have taken such a hit...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sheesh. I take back what I said about you learning to be confident...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's bothering you so much, shut them up with an awesome performance. Like that other time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That other time...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to organize a great event with An that will give everyone the best experience of their lives!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I admit, it looks like you may have the resolve after all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your song was great. Sorry about messing things up before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's right... Shinonome didn't acknowledge me at first, but he changed his mind after seeing me on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Keep your chin high and show them how awesome you are.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...
An's dad told me something like that too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He actually told me that too, back when I had just teamed up with Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, An's still not back.
Let's just go inside.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's fine.
We'll find her inside.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And this way, you won't have to listen to some random guys badmouthing us while they wait for things to start.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um...
Is that his way of being nice to me...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hurry up, you two! Or I'll go on ahead without you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's go, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
Live House

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for listening! I hope you enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Yeah, we loved it!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
Wait, that girl...
Isn't she in the same group as Ken's daughter?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
She has also been doing solo events lately.

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
Cool!
She's definitely getting better each time too!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad tonight went well too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was really nervous and my voice was so shaky when I started doing events on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But now I feel like I can sing just as well as when I'm with An and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They've been itching to have a go at another battle event, so I've gotta keep gaining more experience too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? Coming!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Dad? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Dad?
The next day
The cafe where Minori works

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Kohane!
And thanks for coming all this way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, no. I should be thanking you.
Having you see me while you're working...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. We don't get many customers this early and I'm on a break now anyway.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But what did you mean when you said you want to talk about something urgently?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So here's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Your parents told you to stop doing gigs?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. One of my mom's friends saw me going into a live house alone the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And my dad and mom told me to stop visiting dangerous places like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, why were you alone? Don't you sing with your friends from Kamiyama?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Most of the time, yes. But I've been going solo lately to gain more experience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, really?! That's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I mean, you're working so hard.
How come your parents are against it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Didn't they know from the start that you've been performing in live houses?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They did. But I didn't tell them that I'd also be going alone sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And that's probably what made them really worried.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess some people still believe that live houses are dangerous places where shady people hang out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Up until now, my parents were always supportive of whatever I've wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That would be a big shock...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd be crushed too if my parents told me to stop being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Have you talked about this with your friends yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, not yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
They've helped me out so much already...
I don't really want to drop this on them too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so worried that I may not be able to sing with them anymore...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You know what, I think you should talk to them about this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait... B-But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane...
You've talked to me about your friends before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And from what you've said, it sounds like you really like singing with them, and they care about you as much as you do about them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's true...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I understand that you don't want to worry your group, but I really think you should talk to them about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're a team, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're right. I hate being a nuisance but...
I'll talk to An and the others about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for hearing me out, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you still okay for your break?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? It's okay, I still have some time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then want to have some of this parfait?
I remember you mentioning that you like
the macarons and cream that come with it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?! But you ordered it for yourself. I can't...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You lent me an ear, so I want to treat you.
Here, have some!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Are you really sure?!
In that case, if you don't mind...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mmm! Yum!
Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for being there for me, Minori!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks again for the advice you gave me the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I did like you said and talked with everyone else about what was happening.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's great! So, how did it go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They were really helpful!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks to them, the misunderstanding my parents had also got cleared up and they're letting me carry on like normal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?
That's awesome, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! And it's all thanks to your encouragement that I was able to talk to everyone about this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm glad I could help!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know, if there's ever anything you need help with, please let me know! I'll do whatever I can to help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll be counting on you then!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can't wait for today's practice...
Oh, isn't that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane! Are you heading to the park?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am! Let's go together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm so relieved that everything turned out fine.
Toya's over his problems with his dad,
and you can keep singing like usual.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just talking about that with a friend at school today too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I actually told her about my parents being against me performing at live houses a little sooner than everyone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry about that.
I should've come to you guys first.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just really scared that I might not be able to sing with you again, and I didn't want to be a bother...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you ended up asking her first?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah... I'm so sorry, An.
You're my partner and I...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Don't be such a worrywart!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, if you kept it a secret from me for a whole week or something, then it might start bugging me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It'd be impossible for me to keep quiet about it that long. You would definitely have noticed that something was eating away at me by then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's true! But I'm curious...
What did your friend tell you about this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. She told me to talk to you about it.
Also, she said not to worry about asking
because you mean so much to me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really...? Wow, she seems pretty cool...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She is!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And even though that time I talked to her first...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: From now on, if I have any worries concerning our group, I'll talk to you right away, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a good girl!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I promise not to keep Shinonome or Aoyagi in the dark either.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
They've been singing together longer than us,
so I know I can count on their advice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Akito's actually opened my eyes to some things too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But if anything comes up, I'll also go to you first from now on, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, there they are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's with that grin on your face?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just happy that we can keep singing together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's this all the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah... I know how you feel, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Neither of us has to worry about someone being upset by our choices.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
So let's sing our hearts out, guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Shinonome and Aoyagi are so good...
But...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing with everyone like this really is the best. It's just so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, I felt the same way when...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this might be a good place to stop for today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds good! See you all here tomorrow then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, about tomorrow's practice...
Would it be okay if we did it somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's a park nearby with really beautiful cherry blossoms and I sang with my friends there the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was hoping that we could try singing there too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Practicing under the cherry blossoms? That sounds fun! We can have a look around too while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, don't tell me you've never gone to see them before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, seriously?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He did mention that he didn't have much time to play with friends or go to school events since he was so busy learning classical music from his father every day...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But cherry blossoms too...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Since we all have tomorrow off, why don't we start practice early and have a little picnic under the cherry blossoms after we're done?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm totally up for that!
What about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. I'm interested in what we'll actually do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As long as we get a good practice in, I don't care either way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Great! I'll make us some food!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I'll bring some snacks and stuff!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys get us some drinks. Anything from the convenience store should work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait!)
The next day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone, over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, these trees are huge!
And they're in full bloom!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They are... This is nice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started with practice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Phew... That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it felt good to practice in a place where we can sing as loud as we wanted for a change.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. With beautiful cherry blossoms in the background too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? That felt so amazing! Thanks for suggesting this to us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're all enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, it's time for our little picnic!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah! Oh, here...
My mom and I made some rice balls together for today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, are they all seasoned like this?! They're so cute and colorful!

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Line: Yeah, didn't he come and try to start something with you guys when you were still the BAD DOGS?

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. At least you showed him who's boss and made him run back to his own turf...

rows.Speaker: Youth
rows.Line:
Man, he's such a pain.
On top of that, all he does is go after singers that are just starting out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, so just new people?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane... I hope you're safe...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

Hey, you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Line: Long time no see, Mr. Troublemaker...

rows.Line: B-BAD DOGS...?!

rows.Line:

We're Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: H-Hold on, that little kid... She's with you...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you like singing so much, we'll come play. It's much more fun that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what's it gonna be...?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Line: What?! H-He's famous for being a troublemaker?! I just sang with him like it was nothing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha! Like it was nothing...?!
That's my partner for you...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... But will we be okay? Are you sure he won't come back...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not for some time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. He lost to a shrimp like you, so it's gonna be a while before he can show his face anywhere again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't call her a shrimp!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? It's true, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It feels like I'm actually making good progress.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to keep this up! I need to keep going so that I can catch up with everyone as soon as possible!)
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Today's event went so well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We did really well as a team, but at the same time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It felt like there were more people in the crowd cheering for us than usual!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You may be right. We've even been receiving more praise from other teams.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? I gotta think that us going up against Arata like that is gonna create a lot of buzz too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, one of us may not be too happy about that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Do you have to bring that up every time you talk about that guy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But if we can beat him next time, everyone will know for certain that we came out on top.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know. We have to win as a team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyways, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Okay. I have to keep doing my best as a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD!)

rows.Line: I convinced myself that in order for us to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I needed to become as good as I possibly could.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still believe that I need to get better for us to make our dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But from now on, I'll try relying on you guys more...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Shinonome even said that. I have to make sure that I don't get left behind either!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to keep doing events on my own after what just happened?)

rows.Line: (Hmm... I couldn't really come up with anything good yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If possible, I'd like to think of something on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But maybe I should talk to everyone about this.)

<Everyone!

song00004_off_f

rows.Line: I've seen this so many times already, but they still amaze me every time...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't imagine how exciting it must've been to see this as it actually happened!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, Minori said she kept having trouble with this part of the dance and always fell behind everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it was so cool to see how she was in lockstep with everyone else during the show. Her solo went so well too...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's been worried about how her fans haven't been giving her the same respect as the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I'm sure this show changed that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, Minori, you've always...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (You've always had this sparkling smile on your face ever since we met and you told me about your dream.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't describe how amazing you are, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's why I need to do my best to be able to sing up there with An too...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, are you watching...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The joint stream between Nanamin and MORE MORE JUMP! Actually, I've already seen it a few times...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A few?! More than once?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though you were surrounded by famous idols, you still ended up shining just as brightly as they did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Your performance was so encouraging and uplifting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?! I don't know what to say...! Thank you so much, Kohane!

rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, also...!

rows.Line: Can I ask you about how you practiced before your show? I'd like to try what you did during my practices to, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Line: But I don't know how helpful it'll be...

rows.Line: We kind of just practiced nonstop. Start in the morning, come back during lunch and finish up after school.

rows.Line: The week before our show, we'd even have a second practice after just finishing another one.

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Minori was sleeping at her desk during breaks too...)

rows.Line: I'm good at learning dance routines, but making each step look good takes me a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why you were practicing so hard each day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. If only I had a little more natural talent.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She worked so hard for that show, for her fans...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That explains why she looked so cool and shined so brightly during that show.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for your help, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, don't mention it!
Will it actually help?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! You taught me that I can't take shortcuts to getting better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll make sure to practice right so that I can stand up and perform alongside my teammates!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay! I'll be rooting for you!
I know you can do it, Kohane!

rows.Line: Not me but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These two...

rows.Line: Oh, could it be...?

rows.Line: What happened with Tono left you with no time for schoolwork?

rows.Line: But I told them so many times to be mindful of these things...

rows.Line: Everybody makes mistakes, so let's try not to worry too much about failing a couple tests, okay?

rows.Line: Oh, that's why they're making you take it.

rows.Line: So how many points above failing were you two?

rows.Line: Nine...

rows.Line: Really?! You were so close!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: As tough as this sounds, try your best. I'll try to find some good studying music in the meantime.

rows.Line:
I'll even throw in some drinks.
Promise to study hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...!
Thank you so much!!

rows.Line: Now, we should get started...

rows.Line: Shiraishi's on Classics and Akito has to do English. I'll help Akito with English, and Azusawa...

rows.Line: Yeah, here...

rows.Line: Oh, you missed a lot of points in the vocab section...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: If only you gave this as much attention as you do when it comes to singing...

rows.Line: I was trying to do things efficiently...

rows.Line: Guessing which questions will most likely be asked isn't the same as studying efficiently...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, fine. My bad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Line: Let's get started too, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This phrase usually means...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Interesting, charming, cute or something along the lines of being touching in some way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right, I get that...!
But this other one, uh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, spoon feeding her answers won't help her learn that stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In the event that they do fail the make-up exam, they'll be forced to take classes on the weekend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They'll even be put on the secret blacklist of students with bad grades that the teachers made.

rows.Line: What?! A blacklist...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you actually believe in stuff like that? There's no way something like that actually exists.

rows.Line: Yeah, there's no way!

rows.Line: But there's also the saying, Where there's smoke, there's fire.

rows.Line: D-Does that mean something like that could actually exist...?

rows.Line: (What do we do if they do put An on the blacklist...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, everyone else might start making fun of her for that too...)

rows.Line: Look, it's Shiraishi. I heard she had to take a make-up again after she bombed it the first time.

rows.Line: Aww, poor her...

rows.Line: Hey, how about we have Shiraishi do all our homework so she'll get better at studying?

rows.Line: Hm? Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Let's just start by expanding your vocabulary! Try to memorize everything on these two pages in the next ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya, why did you have to say that?! Kohane's not gonna show me any mercy now...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you'll have to move at least at that pace to get through this today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You too, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They might be at this a while.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're probably right.

Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for lending me so much of your time talking with me like this, MEIKO.

rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Come back anytime.

rows.Line: Thank you too, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like we talked about in SEKAI, I'll try doing what I can to have more confidence in myself!

rows.Line: Great! I'll try coming up with some ideas that can help you out too!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But still, so much happened today.)

rows.Line:
Well...
I'd say you're lacking...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Commitment.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. You have this incredible talent for singing, Azusawa, but haven't fully realized it yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that's what that person meant by what they said.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Commitment and confidence...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Until I decided to ask everyone about it, I couldn't figure out what that person meant...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is my lack of confidence also a part of why that happened?)

rows.Line: In the beginning, I thought us not having enough confidence in ourselves was our biggest weakness...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that it might actually be our biggest strength now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I knew even before this that not having that sort of confidence wasn't a good thing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I really appreciate how Shinonome went out of his way to say what he meant.)

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: Hey, nice work earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, it's one of the other teams from today's event!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (N-Nice work?! All I did was greet everyone and...!)

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line:
Hey, don't tease her like that.
You're scarin' the poor thing.

rows.Speaker: Musician C
rows.Line: Sorry about that. They still haven't gotten over losin' to you yet is all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, when I met them, I think they said they were high schoolers too. But they seem much older than me...)

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: But we've been hearin' all about you, Little Miss Diva! I get why you joined up with Akito and his crew.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! I'm still nowhere near as good as them, really...

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: Haha! Then we're really in trouble, huh? Looks like we still got a looong way to go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no!
I'm so sorry! I didn't mean it that way...!

rows.Speaker: Musician C
rows.Line: You're really as modest as everyone's been sayin'...

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line:
What did I say about teasin' her?!
But there is somethin' I wanna ask you.

rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: Yeah. We tried to get a hold of you after the event, but this one got all depressed over the results...

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: Dude, shut up! She doesn't have to know that!

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: What I'm tryin' to ask is, what sort of stuff do you work on every day...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean, how do I practice?

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: Yeah. I heard you started singin' just a little while ago. What did you do to get this good this fast?

rows.Line: An, Shinonome and Aoyagi all show me what to do during practices...

rows.Line: Um, here's a sample of what we've been working on. It's all handwritten, so I apologize if it's not completely legible...

rows.Speaker: Musician C
rows.Line: You sure?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, of course. At least, I think it's okay...

rows.Speaker: Musician C
rows.Line:
Then if you don't mind...!
You guys work on fundamentals and stuff more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we do. But that's just what we usually do on our own. The other side has what we do day to day.

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: The other side? Oh whoa, it's different each day...

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: This is about what we really need to be doin', huh?

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: But can you tell me this? What percentage of your time do you spend practicin' alone?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What percentage? Oh, I'm sorry. I should've made that clear from the start...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We do everything on the front every day and everything listed for each day on the back.

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line:
Wait, hold up!
You do everything on the front every single day?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we do...!

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: And your teammates do about the same..?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Not quite.
Shinonome practices even more than I do. I believe Aoyagi does as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An has to help out at home, so she ends up practicing about as much as I do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd actually like to do more, but they told me to start with this and see how things go from there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: We weren't takin' this seriously enough at all...

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: Yeah. This was an eye-opener.

rows.Speaker: Musician C
rows.Line: It was.

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: You said your name is Azusawa, right? I'm glad we got a chance to talk to you...

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line: We ain't losin'... No, we aren't going to lose next time. Not to you or Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course!
And we'll be waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Phew...
They really took me by surprise there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I could tell that they're trying to go as high as they possibly can too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Their performance was also really good, so I should keep them in mind moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, they were so surprised by how much we practice too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I never actually thought about it since I was so obsessed with trying to catch up to An and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But that does also sound like I'm suffering from tunnel vision.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND as a team, I need to figure out how to broaden my horizons and have more confidence in myself.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so excited for today's practice. It'll be the first time we practice doing this song together.)

rows.Speaker: Band Member A
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...!
You're Kohane Azusawa from Vivid BAD SQUAD, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Y-Yes, I am!

rows.Speaker: Band Member A
rows.Line:
See, I knew it!
Sorry to bother you like this, but we were performing just over there and wondering if you wouldn't mind hopping in for a quick song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Band Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
We're all huge Vivid BAD SQUAD fans!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Fans?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (W-What do I do?! I've talked to some of the regulars before at events and An's place...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They look close to my age. But what they said just made my face turn completely red...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, they went out of their way to ask me, and I still have time until I have to go...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, if you'll have me.

rows.Speaker: Band Members
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Band Member A
rows.Line: Thank you so much for doing this, Azusawa! That was so amazing and loads of fun!

rows.Speaker: Band Member B
rows.Line: I know we sounded a little iffy back there, but you really just carried us the whole way through...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, please don't say that.
I had a lot of fun too!

rows.Speaker: Band Member B
rows.Line: You did? That's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Band Member A
rows.Line: We loved being able to hear you sing like you did during STAY GOLDEN, but I guess we haven't quite reached your level yet.

rows.Speaker: Band Member B
rows.Line: Haha. So true.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, really, please don't say that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's true that I tried to sing so that it matched better with their own performance...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I'm not sure I'd be able to sing the way I did then even if someone asked me to...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How on earth did I actually do that?)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, this isn't right either...
That time, it was more...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Stop! What are you rushing ahead like that for?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
It felt different and I just...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Felt different from what?
Did we mess up somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for not being able to pick up on it either. Would you mind telling us what's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... It doesn't have to do with how we're harmonizing or anything...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just... I haven't been able to sing like how I did during STAY GOLDEN...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what's bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you did say that you don't really remember what happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. I was just having so much fun singing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wish I could remember what I did so I can always sing like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But trying to means you've already taken your first steps. Punching above your weight like that might also have something to do with the crowd and the venue.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. You still remember that it happened, so I don't think you have anything to worry about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! It's like riding a bike! Once you figure it out, you never forget how to!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like riding a bike...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you've never heard that before? They say you can ride a bike even after not riding one for like decades.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right, I've heard that before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you still chose a weird example.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! How?!
It's the perfect example, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, An!
I understand how you feel... I think? But it's okay, I know how to ride a bike...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That doesn't actually have anything to do with what we're talking about. Again, weird example.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe she's trying to say that your body has already learned to do it, so you have nothing to worry about, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah! What he said!
Nice one, Toya!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, you took a huge step forward that time, so you should be proud of what you accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we're doing that part over again. Don't rush ahead this time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I actually managed to sing confidently like I wanted.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
You were able to sing like that because you were able to find the answer yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing my best so that I can keep singing with them!)
Swimming Beach

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This was so much fun, but it's really coming to an end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We'll be on the bus home soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we're still here and we still have time, so it's not over yet!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, Emu's right!
Let's have as much fun as we possibly can until we have to get on that bus!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What should we do first?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, pick me! There's actually this place I want to check out♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I went exploring when I had some free time and found a spot where there's a ton of shells and sparkly rocks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sparkly rocks...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about sea glass?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, those!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, sea glass...!
I've been wanting to find some too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then let's go see!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! This way, everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here we are♪
Let's start looking!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Emu!
Alright, time to find some sea glass...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I found some!
I see piles of small ones here and there too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right! They're so colorful!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, they are!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wonder if we could make something since there's so much.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Emu, are you not taking any?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I will. Later.
I'm looking for stars right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Stars?
Are you looking for a starfish?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, they're really really small. A lot smaller than a starfish.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When I was little, my mom went to do volunteer work on this tropical island and brought back this little bottle full of tiny stars!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It came from a tropical island...?
Was it a bottle of star sand?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I think it was too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm not really sure if you'll be able to find any here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that may be quite challenging. The water here would need to be very clean and rife with live coral reefs like in the tropics...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess you're right. That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds like there's only a few places in the world where you can find them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But star-shaped sand does sound really cool. I don't think I've ever seen any before.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I wonder how they became that way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe they were like that to begin with? No, they'd become round like sea glass over time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if they're rocks that become all pointy really easily?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As they're tossed and turned in the water, they'll bump into lots of things and eventually become stars!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I heard somewhere once that they're the remains of a certain type of microbe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I believe you're right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'd hate to ruin their fun since they seem to be enjoying themselves so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We found so much sea glass!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! We might even be able to make something using them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I was wondering if we could do that too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like decorating a photo frame with them or something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A photo frame?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! You could take an ordinary wooden or plastic photo frame from the store and paste sea glass on them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You could even make a sort of mosaic with them and give the photo frame more life.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! And we could frame pics from our Seaside School trip in them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That's a super wonderhoy idea!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree! I still wasn't sure what gifts to bring back for everyone, but this would be perfect.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you mind telling us how to make them, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna learn too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
But we'll need to find some suitable photo frames for our sea glass first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean we're gonna go shopping sometime soon?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! That sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then why don't we pick a date that works for all of us while we head back to our room?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, they are!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane!
Welcome back from the Seaside School!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna go ask my dad to see if I can take a break. Would you mind finding yourself an open seat in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that you're back, I wanna hear all about your trip.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you were in the same group as someone who does shows at Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! The younger sister of the person, Tsukasa, whom Aoyagi looks up to so much was there too. Her name's Saki.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I didn't know his sister went to Miya Girls!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She does. It was just surprise after surprise with our group.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki also knows the first friend I made in high school really well too, so we decided to have lunch together sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Saki's childhood friend was in our group too! They even said that they're in a band now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We even ended up talking a lot about singing and performing together at a show or an event in the future!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're in a band? That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And yeah, I bet it would be pretty fun to sing with them! I can't even begin to think how awesome it would be for us to all be on stage together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know, right?! Oh, but Saki also said that they're still just starting out, so they haven't performed in any events or anything yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They seem to really want to start playing for people and find ways to become as good as they can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So they're pretty serious about this, huh? I'm looking forward to working with them even more now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway... Day one of the Seaside School involved swimming, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki and I aren't particularly good swimmers, but Honami, Saki's friend and our groupmate, helped teach us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We also smashed watermelons, practiced our song for the last day, and made curry together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, you guys packed a lot of stuff into one day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that curry you made looked so good too! I really loved how you cut carrots into little stars and hearts! They looked so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we sort of decided to do that on the fly, but I'm glad we did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But Honami also looked really nervous the whole time since she knew Saki didn't have much cooking experience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! She taught you two how to swim and was worried sick about her friend? Are you sure she's not her mom or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That thought crossed my mind too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, about your curry! I showed Akito and Toya that picture you sent me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I told them that you were enjoying yourself and Toya seemed genuinely glad that you were having fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito just scoffed at your picture and was like all, Whatever...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think he was turned off by all the decorative carrots you made for it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He really doesn't like carrots, does he?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, did anything happen here while I was gone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not much on my end.
I was busy the whole time helping out here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito and Toya ran into one of Akito's old friends and ended up doing a performance for the Summer Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think they were trying to mix in a dance routine for a change too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? I wish I was there to see it!

rows.Speaker: An
