rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure you will soon! I heard that they practiced a ton with Len to get it down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They said that they want to show us in SEKAI sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's great! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me neither! Not only that, we'll be able to get back to our usual routine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know it's only been a few days, but each day felt so long since we weren't really practicing like normal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... I felt the same way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We practiced singing our song for the last day a lot and I even practiced some on my own, but all of it just made me want to return to being Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really made me realize how lucky I am to have teammates like you, Akito and Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right back at you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...! I got a little ahead of myself talking about what I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: These fish-shaped oshikura-manju are for you and your dad, An! And this is for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Hey, can I open it now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sure...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope she likes it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a photo frame...!
Wait, are these pieces of sea glass? They're gorgeous...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My group managed to find some on the very last day of the Seaside School.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We found enough to try and make a sort of mosaic of them for some photo frames.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, hold on! You're saying that you made this yourself, Kohane?! I totally thought that this was store-bought!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can really have this?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! I hope you get a chance to use it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
I promise to cherish it and find a good picture to put in it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But which one would be best...?
Oh, that one with us in front of the cherry tree might work!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. I'm so glad that she likes it. It was worth the effort.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll have to make sure to give Shinonome and Aoyagi their gifts too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you make photo frames for them too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, these seemed a little too girly for them, so I brought back some snacks for them instead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm giving them the same fish-shaped oshikura-manju that I gave you and your dad just now. Apparently, where we stayed is really famous for them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I don't blame you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm sort of wondering how they'd react if you gave them the photo frame you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope I see them soon. I'm really looking forward to giving them their gifts.)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
Okay, that should be enough for today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, good work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're gonna stick around, right?
How about your usual?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An.
Can I get extra whipped cream, caramel sauce and nuts with mine?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Extra whipped cream, caramel sauce and nuts! You got it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, again?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, how has practice been going for... The Fan Festival, was it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's been going great too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime gave me some really good dance tips.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right. Isn't one of Toya's classmates in that troupe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, her name's Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Her included, it feels like we've been having so many strange encounters lately...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: From my classmate to Tsukasa's younger sister's childhood friend to actual idols.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, funny you should mention that. Minori's the first friend I ever made in high school too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And she ended up forming an idol group with my childhood friend?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, here's your order.
That should be everything, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. I mean, we all live in the same city, so it isn't that huge a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Geez, way to take the fun out of it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, An, have you had a chance to talk to Haruka recently?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me? Hmm... We spoke once when she came here after she quit being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She was here?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, a few times.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...! A former A-list idol came here in private! This place is so amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! It's not like that. Haruka's just an old friend, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? I discovered this place by complete happenstance and started meeting all these new people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Including you, An, and Shinonome and Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only that, but after I started singing, I got to become friends with this girl in my class who plays the bass!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, she's one of Ichika and Saki's childhood friends too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Then, that means I must've met her during the Doll Festival...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'd love to introduce everyone to Shiho and Honami someday.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. So much has really happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hearing you sing, An, discovering Weekend Garage, you asking me to be your partner...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You even gave yourself a complete makeover as proof of your resolve.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that really was a huge surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Also, I never imagined the four of us joining together to form a team back then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
We have Miku and the others to thank for that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. They showed us that we were all striving towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But being sent over to SEKAI without really knowing what was going on was pretty startling too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. You had a fight with your partner and were all alone...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And now, we're going over there on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More than that in your case. Haven't you been spending entire days off reading over there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's a very relaxing place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Miku and the others are all so nice too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, are you including KAITO?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha... I'm sure he's a nice guy deep down, but yeah, he is a bit of a troublemaker...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, I genuinely believe that Weekend Garage is the reason behind me meeting all these wonderful people.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I dunno. We didn't exactly get off on the right foot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane's trying to show her appreciation, so ease off...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You too...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Minori, Ichika, Kusanagi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We'll be performing at the Fan Festival together, so I'll do what I can to make the most of this opportunity.)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm guessing practice went well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it did! But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's pretty crowded today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Not exactly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: None of us had anything else to do and we all just happened to gather here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Welcome, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane, you're all done with the Fan Festival now, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How'd it go? I really wanna know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, sure.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, that must've been pretty wild!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It totally was!
Especially since Kohane was in the lineup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-An...!
You don't need to exaggerate...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, those two things don't have anything to do with each other.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, they do!
A ton of people seemed completely blown away by Kohane's singing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You even had this dumb grin on your face probably out of wanting to gloat about her being your teammate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see. So, Toya, did Akito have a smug grin on his face then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe... Yes, he did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: T-Toya...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha. I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's nothing to be ashamed of. You're all on the same team.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's hard not to feel a little embarrassed in front of your closest friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can sympathize.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What are you talking about, KAITO? You're just you, no matter where you are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, can't you say that a little nicer...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, you guys, that's enough teasing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, also, you performed at the Fan Festival with some friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I take it that it ended up being a good experience for all of you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We talked about what we work on during our own practices and even exchanged pieces of advice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We even talked a lot about what hobbies we like and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but that always ended up becoming a discussion about songs and music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds just like you guys.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They really love music too, huh?
I guess it's only natural that your conversations gravitated towards that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like music's given me so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Finding Weekend Garage turned into me meeting you, An, and picking up singing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Music's given me so many new friends too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me being here and meeting all these new friends is also because of you guys, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You pushed me towards wanting to sing, Miku, and you helped me become more outgoing than before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Without all of you, I wouldn't have discovered what my true feelings were, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be thanking you as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your thoughts and feelings are what gave birth to this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You guys never cease to amaze us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Seeing all of you work so hard towards reaching the top is really encouraging and heartwarming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just don't give up on surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but I'm sure you'll be able to as long as you keep doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone here's on our side, so we've totally got this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry about making you all take a detour before the night show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I felt that I should say “hi” to Emu and the others since we're here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to see them, Haruka, An?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd feel bad about taking up time before the start of their big show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure we'll get another chance to see them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, Kohane and I are gonna go talk to them for a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, have fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... Do you see any of them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I guess they really are busy. Maybe it wasn't such a good idea to do this just before their show's about to start...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Kohane! Minori!
You came to see us?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Emu! I'm so glad we found you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I wanted to thank you guys for helping us out when we were getting ready for the Fan Festival. Do you have some time to talk?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Nene! Rui!
Kohane and Minori came to see us☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, well met, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, it's been a while!
Thank you so much for the way you helped me out during the Fan Festival!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that? It was nothing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're both in the business of spreading hope and making others smile. It's only natural for us to lend each other a hand since we work so hard every day!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. What a windbag.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, anyway.
Are you two staying for the night show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We heard that it uses all of PXL as a stage, so we're both really excited!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You are?! Hehe. That means we have to make it extra fun this time♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we should... Why don't we send Tsukasa flying a little higher than usual as a special surprise?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That won't be necessary.
Also, there's no scene in this show involving that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More importantly, don't forget to get a bracelet from one of the staff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's for the climax, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. You get a signal during the show to raise it in the air.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
We made things even more fun recently by adding in some lucky bracelets♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Lucky bracelets?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what do you think she means by “lucky”...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll just have to wait and find out♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, we'll be looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “No...! Master...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“The lights went out...
The horses and the flying rides...
They've all just stopped...!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Shao...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa... All the lights are going dim...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is what PXL looks like when it's completely dark? It's like everything that was fun and happy here just vanished...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm getting goosebumps from how well it goes with Shao's story.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is unbelievable... It's literally using all of PXL as its stage...

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“Wait, no...
This is no time to be crying...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “If what Master said is true, that means I can...! No, we can...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone...!! Can you hear me?!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
We can hear you, Shao!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone, please! Lend me your energy!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “This was the last thing Master told me! Everybody here can use magic because you're all smiling, laughing and making this such a happy place...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I can't do this alone! I'm not as good at using magic like Master was, so please, lend me your energy...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Lend me your smiles, your joy, your magic...!!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's our signal!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright!
We're gonna give you everything we have, Shao!

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line: Whoa, her bracelet's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Visitor B
rows.Line: Oh wow! It's a rainbow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Wh-Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, Minori... Isn't that one of the “lucky bracelets” Otori was talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally is! I mean, you're the only rainbow one around here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Minori!
Oh, I should take a photo of it!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Alright, let's use your magical smiles to bring light back to this place!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Wave!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori, try pointing your bracelet at some trees or buildings like Emu's doing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay! I'll try...!
Wave!

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line:
Whoa, the lights!
They're gorgeous...

rows.Speaker: Visitor B
rows.Line: Hey, I think we can do it too...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori, turn this way!
And strike a pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's a great expression!
Alright, one more...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Wave! Huh...?
Mommy, it's not working.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that's too bad...
We must not have enough magic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would you like to keep trying with me? Here, we can do it together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, money shot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Girl
rows.Line: Wave!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Wow, we lit them all up!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Kohane's so enamored in taking pictures.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
She and her dad like photography.
Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's dad apparently likes taking pictures of her more than anything else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can see why. She's just like Minori in terms of being capable of so many facial expressions...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! I totally get how her dad feels.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we take some as well?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...? A-An, Haruka?!
Were you taking photos of me?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, busted!
No, wait. This just means we should be taking more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, An! This is so embarrassing!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's so cool...!
You can make the fireworks in the background move!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for teaching me this, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I take it your album's coming along well?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is! And I'd like to try doing the rest on my own from here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I really hope An likes it.)
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for agreeing to meet with me. I know you're busy helping out right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, you're fine! Things are finally starting to calm down, so you don't have anything to worry about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what is it that you wanted to show me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember how we all went to Phoenix Wonderland together the other day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I put together a digital album using all the photos I took.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A digital album?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you can see it on your phone. That way, we don't have to print out anything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And it's easy to share too.
I'll send you it right now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, got it!
Okay... Download.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It should start playing on its own, so if you don't mind just letting it go for a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure!
Oh, it's starting...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. This one!
From when we were at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You were so surprised when your order came.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was so much more than I expected. But it was good, so it ended up being worth it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There should be one of you eating it too. Oh, I think it's this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I look way too happy eating this thing! It's pretty embarrassing now that there's evidence of me doing this too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, it moved to the next one!
Huh? What's with all these stars and flowers...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everything's digital so it's easy to add stickers and stamps like these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some of them can sparkle and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's really cute! You did an amazing job with these! Wait, this looks like it took a really long time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not really. My dad showed me how, so it ended up being pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it took me longer to choose which photos would go into this album...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, there were just so many good ones!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That means these are the best of the best in your opinion, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, the night show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...?
Why are you grinning?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because the photos of the fireworks from the night show are about to appear. Look closely...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Okay...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, here we go... What the?!
The fireworks in the back are moving! How?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My dad showed me how to do this too, and I spent some time getting it to do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't have time to get the sound to work, but I think I got them to fire off right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's like a movie at this point!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But now I get why you were grinning the way you were. This was what you wanted to show me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's right.
It might even be the best part of this album.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm glad she likes it so much. It was really worth the effort.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, that was great...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You sent this to Haruka and Minori too, right? I'm sure they'll love it as much as I did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is actually just for you and me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this album was mostly just photos of us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. I made a separate one like this for Minori and Haruka, and another one for all four of us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So it's really our special album?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you made them for all of us? That had to take forever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it really didn't! I had a lot of fun putting them together, and I'm hoping that we all get to keep enjoying these memories.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Gotcha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But at the same time, you doing all the giving doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Dad! Can I give Kohane some extra cream and caramel sauce on the house?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! No, you don't have to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nonsense. I won't rest until you do, alright?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay... In that case, I accept. Thanks...
Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, camping was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It really was!
We had an early start, so it'll be nice to head home for the day and rest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we have another hour on this train. What do we do until we arrive?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's true.
On the way there, we could talk about what we'd be doing... What should we do for the way back?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, how about cards...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I brought some with me, but we didn't really have time yesterday. What if we played something now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do that!
Nice one, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Cards...?
I remember Tsukasa teaching me the rules of some games.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, I learned how to play Old Maid, President and Sevens...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Tsukasa? Not anyone from his family...? Does that mean he didn't really play many games at home growing up...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He taught you...?
He didn't teach you anything weird, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, nothing unorthodox as far as I could tell.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Although, he personally liked to strike a pose each time he made a pair. Luckily, he didn't make anyone else do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So he's always been like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
Then, why don't we start with Old Maid? Mind handing me the cards, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, every card's been dealt out! What order should we go in...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Clockwise, I guess?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Let's start with you, Kohane! Draw something from my hand!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, let me see what's in my hand first...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I... I have the joker...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I can't let the others find out...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Lemme guess, you got the joker...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
N-No, what are you talking about...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She has it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's get started.
Take your pick, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Um... This one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that didn't help...
Even though I have so many cards.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm next.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, he'll know where the joker is if I keep staring at it. Just play it cool and look away...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's like she can't hide what she's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that makes a pair.
I should be done in no time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! No fair, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito's always had been pretty good at these games. It's as if he can find the exact cards that he needs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, there's no way I can do that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(N-No...
I'm gonna lose if this keeps up...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There, I win.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! A-Already?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was way too fast! You know this is a game, right? You should be having more fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What choice did I have? All I did was avoid what I thought was the joker and voila.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (N-No, I knew this would happen...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So now, Shiraishi, you'll be taking from my hand, and Azusawa will be taking from yours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Eeny, meeny, miny... Mo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Drats, another dud...
Oh well. Alright, Kohane, your turn.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
How about this one...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait.. Yay!
That's what I needed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, good for you!
Hold on... You're down to one card!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right... Once you take this from me, Aoyagi, I'm out, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me! I was so sure that Toya would never draw the joker...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, Kohane gets second.
You did pretty well for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks.
I was so worried about what would happen if the joker stayed in my hand, but I'm glad everything worked out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now it's just me and you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're on! There's no way I'm losing this one!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe... I didn't expect to finish so quickly...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I should take a photo on my phone while I still have a chance.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll just move away a bit to get them all in the frame and... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, why's that one sticking out like that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa taught me that it's more of a mental game in these situations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What, like psychological warfare...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Geez, it's the joker too...
Talk about an old-school tactic.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
This has to be the joker...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(But Toya's really smart...
It could be something completely different. What if he just wants me to think it's the joker...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But what if that's his actual strategy? What if he's doing this to make me think that...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Arrgh... My head's starting to hurt!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't see Aoyagi's hand from here, but I have to think that's the joker...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even if it is, he has four other cards. Just in terms of probability, it really just seems better to pick a card other than the one that's sticking out...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's An gonna do...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Forget it!
Thinking won't help me at this point!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm going with you, middle card!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Akito
rows.Line: That's...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Did I do something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Noooo! I-It's the joker!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like this battle is mine, Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-You monster...!!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And a pair of twos to finish things off...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I lost...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That became such a heated battle in the end...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but Toya's poker face gave him the upper hand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I got unlucky! That's all!
We're playing again! Right now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
As you wish, Shiraishi.
I'll be sure to pass the joker to you again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Grr...!
I'm not losing this time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, round two it is!
A week after the camping trip.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we can head over to practice once we're done drinking these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, can I have a minute before we do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I finished putting together the digital album for our camping trip.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Would you like to take a look before we start practice?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A digital album? Like the one you made for Haruka, Minori and me after we went to PXL?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I had my dad help me with that one, but I made it all on my own this time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, now I see why you wanted us to send you any photos we took during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since our trip was all about us envisioning the same thing as we sing a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I thought it'd be nice to have something that can remind us of what we saw and experienced together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa... The ones you took in continuous mode look pretty much like a video.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is awesome!
This makes it so easy to remember what we thought or felt at any particular point!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And just the sheer number of photos... You took so many different kinds too, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! Everything from landscapes to these little birdies... She captured us really well too. Oh, here's one of me cooking. I look like I mean business♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought about using just the ones where we're smiling at first, but I feel like this gives us a much better picture of what happened during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, here's one of An looking really depressed after not being able to figure out how to pitch that tent.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I figured out that you had to follow a certain order to stick the poles in, didn't I?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you didn't remember the actual order, so that doesn't really count.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad you suggested that we divide up roles, Shinonome. That really helped us out a lot in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, and sounding like you knew what you were doing helped too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
When's this one from...?
Akito seems very worried...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that happened while you were chopping vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was hoping to get a picture of each of us prepping for dinner, but I couldn't resist taking this one... The expression on Shinonome's face was so priceless.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, you're right.
His brow's almost as furled as Toya's!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, you worrywart!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Quiet, you.
Wouldn't you also be worried if someone was holding a knife for the first time?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for making you feel that way. I promise to be more careful so that you can be at ease next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, but it's not like we're gonna be using knives all that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this one has Azusawa in it... And Shiraishi in front of her, I think...? You look mad for some reason, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I took that one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An was sneaking in a few bites but got caught by Kohane and then she got mad at her. It was too funny to not take a picture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It wasn't funny and you didn't have to do that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe... Oh, look.
It's us picking those wild plants.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was a really long album!
But really good too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for making that for us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for going through it with me! I'm really glad I made it now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It certainly helped us remember everything that happened and all that we gained during our trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we start practice while that's still fresh in our minds?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm glad they like it so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope we get more chances to take trips like that in the future, together.)
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we made our wishes and got a nice start to the new year! Not bad at all!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I feel the same.
I'm also happy that we were able to make this visit together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you never know when an experience like this will come in handy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It even comes with a “great blessing” as the cherry on top! That means Vivid BAD SQUAD's really gonna rock the city this year!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the only person who actually drew a “great blessing”...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't think I read the part about education in my fortune yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Education?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah... Oh, thank goodness!
“Your efforts will be rewarded”...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? I wonder what mine says...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see... “Fortune favors the studious”...! Awesome! That means I won't fail anything, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not so sure about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It all depends on how you interpret that phrase, no? You could very well run into some trouble if you don't study enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. I have a hard time reading this as not having to study at all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, duh. There's no way you'll get good grades if you don't actually work for it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Grr...!
Fine, Mr. Smartypants, what did yours say?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I don't remember...
Honestly, who actually takes this stuff seriously?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Incidentally, I got the same thing as Azusawa. What does yours say, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? What's it say? Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Do not cut corners”... It may be wise to not cram or only study the bare minimum this year for tests and quizzes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, I get it. Sheesh.
I promise not to cut any corners, so quit giving me that look.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so interesting how these fortunes go right along with someone's personality!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I really liked yours, Kohane.
“Follow your heart.” It's so you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what did your guys' part about “Ambitions” say?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Mine says, “Slow and steady wins the race.”
Not really what I wanted to hear, but I guess I don't really have a choice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I got, “Your patience will be rewarded.”
I suppose that means I have something to look forward to now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mine's... “Keep moving forward even when you feel lost.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I actually really like that!
It's like I'm being told to not give up even when things don't look so great.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it's never easy to just go your own way just based on my own experiences...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's so nice that we're getting such words of encouragement from these!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep doing our best, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's one of the trees where we can tie these up. Why don't we go do that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should be tight enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, I'm gonna tie mine next to yours! There! Nice and tight!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's about time we headed back to practice... Hm? There's something written on all these wooden plaques... Oh, are these everybody's wishes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, looks like it.
A whole lot of them too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These are always so fun to look at because of all the different things people are wishing for!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. It's almost like every sort of wish you can think of too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey... Why don't we hang some up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our own wish plaques?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. We all have the same wish, so I was thinking that we could hang one up for all of us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's an awesome idea!
I'll go get one right now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One plaque for four people? Is that allowed...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never heard of any rules saying that each person has to have their own plaque so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back!
We can each have our own quarter.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds more like a thank you card...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Details! Details!
Anyway, Kohane, start us off!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was your idea, so I believe you should go first as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, done...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's tiny. I can barely read that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What are you talking about? Can't you see how adorable that is? Anyway, me next!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you're taking up way too much space...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's easy to read, right?
Also, if you're gonna complain so much, why don't you show us how it's done?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You'll be able to tell that it's our wish plaque from a mile away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Definitely!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm home!
And we're all done with our first practice for the year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was nice to sing as much as we did too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it even ended up becoming a good workout.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's just use this afternoon to relax... Hm?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, sounds like you guys are right back to it on New Year's Day.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, before I go any further...
Happy New Year.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you! A Happy New Year to you too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Happy New Year, Ken.
Let's make the most of this year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Dad, got anything for us to drink?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure, one second.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Alright, let's just chill here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Come to think of it, there's no one else here... Are you closed today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, why?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is it okay for us to be here then?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
You guys are here as my friends today, not customers!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: More importantly... Aren't you all excited? It's the start of a brand-new year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I wonder what this year has in store for us...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't wait for anything to roll into our lap. We gotta make things happen for us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If we don't keep doing everything we possibly can, we won't ever be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're absolutely right...!
We need to keep finding ways to move forward by being proactive...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Look at you, Kohane!
That means I'm gonna have to keep doing my best too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see. We can push each other to a higher level.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm thankful that we were able to become a team of four. It's allowed us to come a very long way in a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You even helped me escape my cage of classical music. I couldn't be more grateful for that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was definitely when I knew I'd made the right decision, so again, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You don't need to thank us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, all we really did was have a little chat.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's not true.
You were all there for me that time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of which... What about that other time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember when I lost after trying to battle Tono alone...? You guys were there to get me back on my feet.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I got clobbered. Without you guys, I probably would've kept dwelling on that and convinced myself that beating him was the only way forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've all been able to take big steps because we always had each other.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Even me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I found the courage to believe in my singing because you were there to cheer me up when I really needed it, An. I'm really grateful for that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You may not realize this, Kohane, but you also helped me find ways to grow. Ever think about that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, really. The way you can make everyone's heart race just with your singing has been huge for me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm not about to let you leave me behind, alright, partner?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also hope we get more chances to bond as a team. Like during our camping trip...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be great!
That trip really taught us a lot too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if we went paragliding in Hawaii or something next time...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're just saying that because you want to do that, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Flying also seems like a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I see your guys' point. I'd love to experience more new things together if possible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By doing so, I have a feeling that we'll find ways to sing even better!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Alright, order up.
Here are your drinks and a light lunch to go with it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, is this a traditional brunch...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! It's Dad's New Year's brunch platter! You've gotta try this, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken, you can make traditional Japanese food...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The black soybeans look very appetizing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? The fish omelets he makes are really amazing too♪

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Isn't this only natural since it's New Year's Day? Also, I'm sure you're all starving.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mmm!
This shrimp's pure yum!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
These braised vegetables are good too...
I had no idea you could make anything like this, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Chef Ken may be more appropriate.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's eat as much as we can so that we grow big and strong!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Isn't that what parents tell their kids when they're little...? But I get your point. Let's make some huge strides this year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? You still have half a Salisbury steak left, Shiho. Are you saving the best for last?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Do you two prefer otherwise?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I might be on your side. There's always a part of me that tells me to hold off eating what I like or what's good since it'll be gone before I know it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know exactly how you feel!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I can't help but eat them first because they're so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's almost like I become totally powerless whenever I'm faced with my favorite things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even when I'm watching idol concerts, I try to sit quietly and absorb what I'm seeing, but I usually end up singing and cheering out loud without realizing it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I sort of get the first part, but your landing was a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand what she's trying to say.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There's so much you can learn or gain by actually going to shows and events.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
You guys are trying to surpass that one event... RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean you watch videos of that event as a team?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
There aren't any as far as I know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
No cameras were allowed during RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's so sad that there aren't any videos of RAD WEEKEND out there...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As a result, I've had to ask An and everyone else about what they witnessed...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. This area has always had a lot of artists, and they put on events all the time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But my dad and his team organized this event called RAD WEEKEND and gathered a bunch of the best ones who really knew how to get a crowd going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was a mix of all sorts of genres, but everyone shared an absolute love of music.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was the coolest event ever! It was so exciting I could barely breathe. I thought my heart was going to explode!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was sort of like... When the four of us battled against Arata during that event, I guess?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As the night went on, one performer after another got up on stage and kept getting the crowd more and more pumped!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everybody wanted to sing! Everybody wanted to hear more! The sky was the limit that night!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone there was so excited and couldn't wait to see what would happen next.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's something you can't really achieve by any normal means. That might be the best way to describe RAD WEEKEND... How's that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An's even told me about everyone who participated in that event along with their set lists so that I have some sort of baseline reference.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I still have to rely on my imagination...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It just isn't the same...
I wasn't there to see RAD WEEKEND happen.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Kohane...?
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You seem really concerned...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's nothing! Really!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, I happen to have three jellies on me right now. Want one?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure, Minori?
I wouldn't want to take away from your lunch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure! After all, this is a special lunch!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your choices are strawberry, orange and melon. Which would you like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really appreciate it, but you should choose first since it's your lunch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, in that case...
I've made my choice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My bet's on the melon one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I thought the same thing.
Minori seems like a melon person.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: C-Correct! How did you two know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same.
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I'm practicing with Taiga then, so I'll head over to the park once we're done.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to learn as much as I can from him today.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In order to surpass RAD WEEKEND!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, what did you think of RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Think you can surpass it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We will... We absolutely will!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I guess An already saw my reply.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only that, I want to be able to teach everyone what I learn.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But what are we gonna do today?
It's always so hard to predict what he has in store for me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We'd be singing one day, listening to music and discussing lyrics the next...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But he'll leave me completely puzzled some days since I won't really know how to apply what we're doing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there was that one time I managed to figure out his little enigma.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, this place...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry, we'll be making a quick detour.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay, I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey! Anyone home?

rows.Speaker: Eatery Owner
rows.Line:
Well if it isn't Taiga!
It's great to see that you're really back!

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, I got back a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe you upped and moved to a better location. Your old place was gone, so I thought you'd gone out of business or something.

rows.Speaker: Eatery Owner
rows.Line: The live house next to my place also ended up moving, so I decided to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Eatery Owner
rows.Line:
But fear not.
My storefront may be new and shiny, but what I make is as good as ever.

rows.Speaker: Taiga's Voice
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean. Things might look different on the outside, but nothing's changed on the inside.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Nothing's changed on the inside...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga's been examining all the places we've been visiting in Vivid Street to see whether or not they've changed, and how much if they have.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess it would be interesting to see how things change after being away for so long...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which leads me to believe that there's a hidden message behind everything we've been doing.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
Thanks for letting me take that detour.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! I-I'm sorry...
I was just thinking about what you two were talking about...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The meaning behind what I've been doing with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example, I've been noticing how you've been taking an interest in how things have changed around here over the years...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I see. Is that your interpretation...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. But I apologize if you think I'm getting the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. I'd say not quite, but you're on the right track.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. Want me to tell you a little secret about what we've been doing so far?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Ever hear this before? They say that about 80% of the information we take in comes from what we see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I think I've heard it on TV before...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You can learn a lot from just people-watching, looking around the city, seeing all the colors and gauging how close or far away certain things are.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But where does that leave our ears?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Our ears...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah.
What can we learn from hearing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We can... Hear how people feel...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly.
That also includes how far away they are and which way they're facing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, our eyes still end up being more powerful than our ears. Which means there's only so much you can do with sound alone.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But we're here to sing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So the question becomes, “How do you make people see through music?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See through music...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah.
More than that depending on the situation.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The lyrics for a song don't always describe things that are grounded in reality. There are times when you have to imagine what's going on yourself.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And it's not just about showing people that. You can also make them remember things from their past...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand eventually.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, my point is that just singing isn't enough. I want you to at least take that away from this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... Seeing through music...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Alright! This just means I need to keep practicing to figure out what he really means by that!
One week until Kohane's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? There's something on my desk...
What is this? An invitation...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wow, it's covered in Phenny stickers!
But wait... It doesn't say who it's from...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Morning, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I found this invitation on my desk when I got here. Do you know who it could be from, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You know who they are, Kohane. I'm sure you'll figure it out once you open it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Okay, I'll take a look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... “You are cordially invited to see a special show we will be putting on to celebrate your birthday.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “You will be able to bring along up to ten of your friends and family besides yourself free of charge. We will be awaiting your arrival.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “As our gift to you, we at Wonderlands×Showtime wish to give you, our 'Number One Fan,' an amazingly wonderhoy birthday celebration!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A special show?! By Wonderlands×Showtime?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Eep! E-Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Operation Surprise Invite went off like a charm♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Operation Surprise Invite?
Does that mean you made this, Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
Allow me to explain further☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You already know about how there's a special plan that lets visitors celebrate their special day at Phoenix Wonderland, right, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. My family and I have been making use of that every year for birthdays.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! The true PXL Master!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. But hold on... That plan just includes a meal in the special Phenny Room where Phenny and his friends stop by for a visit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't remember anything about a special show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. There's a chance of it becoming a part of that package now♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We want everyone who chooses to celebrate their special day at Phoenix Wonderland to have more fun than ever before!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why we asked if the other cast members could help us specially put on an original show as part of that celebration☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An original show?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That sounds amazing! I'm sure everyone who loves PXL also loves the show stage, so they'll probably really enjoy that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right? I asked my brothers and they said we can give it a try♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! Your brothers are the ones who run the park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! They love Phoenix Wonderland just as much and even put together a list of visitors who've already experienced all these plans.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which included your name, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's when they asked me to hear what you think since you're my friend and should give me an honest opinion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, Kohane...
If it's alright with you, we'd like to try putting on a show for you to celebrate your birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! I can't believe this is really happening! Not only that, I get to actually help PXL grow as a park!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks...!
We promise to give you a really, really fun show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Congratulations to you both, Emu, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks! I must be dreaming! Wonderlands×Showtime is gonna celebrate my birthday! I can't wait!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. And they invited you to this special show?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That sounds like so much fun!
Do you think we can get a peek in too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure you'll get that chance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm interested in seeing it as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, just be sure to keep an eye on Rin and Len for me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What happens if KAITO's the one who gets excited for his own good?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't deny that as a possibility.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's when you're supposed to promise it won't happen...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha! I still can't believe they're giving ten of your friends and family free one-day passes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Just for that day. Based on what I was told, they want as many people as possible to see this test show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why you're inviting, Haruka, me and everyone else to come along. Are you gonna have enough left for your mom and dad?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, my dad already has an annual pass, so he's all set. He even said that I should invite as many of my friends as I can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. In that case, let's all go together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not like we have anything else to do since we decided to take a break on her birthday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, that settles that! We're gonna do everything we can to give you as big a celebration as Tsukasa and his troupe!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there's actually someone else I've been meaning to ask!
Kohane's birthday
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Kohane!
Thank you so much for inviting me!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Akiyama! You made it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course! On top of it being your birthday, Kohane, I wasn't about to pass up a chance to participate in something like this♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you gotta hear this. Mizuki was supposed to have supplementary classes to take some tests and quizzes today, but managed to get them out of the way early.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
I'm sorry. I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
Just my way of shaking some of the rust off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, sometimes I have no idea how you pull off these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's it. Shower me with praise.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not happening.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, can you remind me when Minori and her group are gonna meet up with us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, she said they'll meet us at the Wonder Stage because some of them have morning practice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That means we can do whatever we want until then!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Where do you wanna start?
How about the haunted house over there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Wait! It's Kohane's birthday!
Should we go where she wants to go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
When should we let Miku and the others know when to join us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
There's still a chance they'll be seen right now, so probably not until just before the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... Also, it's your birthday. You should be having fun instead of handling logistics. Look, you're keeping An and Akiyama waiting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's all have as much fun as we can today.

rows.Speaker: Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Alright.
Yes, let's.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohaneee!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! Thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, wait!
Sorry, be right back!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This might be a good chance for us to let Len and the others know what's up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I'll leave you to that. We've probably kept them waiting long enough.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting us today, Kohane!
Also, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Kohane.
Here's something from us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, this box is so cute!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What's inside, Haruka?
I promise not to tell Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still a secret. You'll just have to wait until she opens it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew that Minori and Haruka went to the same school, but I didn't realize they knew Kohane too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I should say hi to them♪)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us as well, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you. I know you're busy with band practice and everything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, have you already talked to Tsukasa?
He said he wanted to thank you for agreeing to participate in this test show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? I mean, I feel honored enough to get to see a special show like this on top of helping the park I love so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You really do genuinely love this place, huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Kohane, are your mom and dad here yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
They'll be meeting us here.
I just got word that they're almost here a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line:
“Attention please♪
The show is about to start☆
Everyone, please sit wherever you like!”

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: “Also, we ask that Kohane come to the Wonder Stage and meet us backstage♪”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Me?
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! I'm gonna be in the show?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!
You and Emu will be our brave protagonists!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Can I really do this...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You won't have that many lines, and we'll do everything we can to make sure you, the protagonist, gets to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay. I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let me give you a brief rundown.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The story itself is very simple.
Nene and I were originally in your party but turned evil by dark magic. You'll also need to awaken Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Once your party is whole again, you'll battle against the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But don't worry, it's a quiz battle instead of an actual fight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! You'll look for a member of the audience who you believe will answer my questions in the same way as you, asked them to join you and answer together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When your answers match, your power of friendship will cause this legendary sword to awaken.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow...! That sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
So let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Emu the Brave
rows.Line: “Now, your majesty! I, Emu the Brave, and Kohane the Brave shall venture forth to rescue our friends!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave
rows.Line: “A-And! We vow to defeat the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa using this legendary sword!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Go get 'em, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! D-Dad...

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah hah!
You have done well to come this far, brave warriors!”

rows.Speaker: Nene the Fairy
rows.Line: “But your power of friendship will need to be much stronger than that to awake this legendary sword of yours!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hahaha. Let us see if you have what it takes to defeat me.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Now I need to look for someone who I think will answer his questions the same way!)

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Question #1! Which would you rather have for lunch? A croquette sandwich or yakisoba bun?”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What does that have to do with being a warrior?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <L-Len! Not so loud!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. We should be fine for now. It looks like no one else can see us from here.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Also, this is great!
We'll have to tell MEIKO and the others all about this when we get back.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm glad we came. Kohane really seems to be enjoying herself.>

rows.Speaker: Rui the Wise
rows.Line:
“What say you, Kohane the Brave?!
Who are you going to choose to help you?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave
rows.Line: “U-Uhh... Ichika, please help me!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nice choice, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika's perfect for this one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You should be fine as long as you go with your instinct.

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave
rows.Line:
“Okay, Ichika!
Ready?!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave & Ichika
rows.Line: “Yakisoba bun!!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What?! How did you answer my first question so easily?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui the Wise
rows.Line: “Excellent! Our brave warriors' power of friendship is starting to wake the legendary sword from its slumber!”

rows.Speaker: Emu the Brave
rows.Line: “Keep it up and it'll be awake in no time!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave
rows.Line: “Right!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord Tsukasa
rows.Line: “H-How can this be?! You correctly answered all of my questions?!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave
rows.Line: “It's over, Demon Lord Tsukasa...!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Noooo! Your power of friendship... It's too strong... Guh...”

rows.Speaker: Kohane the Brave
rows.Line: “W-We did it...! We defeated the evil Demon Lord Tsukasa!”

rows.Speaker: Emu the Brave
rows.Line: “Nice job! It's all thanks to you and your friends having such powerful bonds, Kohane!”

rows.Speaker: Rui the Wise
rows.Line: “And with the evil Demon Lord defeated, the world was able to usher in an era of peace...”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Thank goodness there weren't any problems! I really need to thank everyone for...)

rows.Speaker: Rui the Wise
rows.Line: “But we aren't finished just yet!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui the Wise
rows.Line: “Our brave warriors returned home to find that their friends and acquaintances had prepared some special messages to celebrate Kohane's birthday.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, it's surprise message time!
Starting with us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Azusawa.
I'm glad you had fun as our brave protagonist today. I hope we get to hang out like this more in the future...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Between Miya Girls and Kamiyama High, you've assembled quite the party for us today! Be sure to cherish your friends, and from all of us to you, we hope to see you again!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good friends aren't easy to come by, so I hope you and your friends were able to have a fun and memorable time during our show today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know I did! It was super duper extra amazingly fun doing this show with you, Kohane! I hope we get to do this again sometime! Happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
“Happy birthday, Kohane!”
“Kohane, happy birthday!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You were so cool on stage, Kohane.
Not only are you already a great singer, but you can also act. I was so impressed by how poised you were.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Seeing you go from being adorably cute to kicking butt was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree. At the same time, seeing you surprised at the end there was just as adorable.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was clear that you really put your best foot forward. Great show today, and... I hope we get to hang out more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
Hehe. Thank you so much for choosing me for the second question! The one about rice ball ingredients!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It was wonderful how these questions show how much you have in common with your friends in terms of hobbies, what foods you like and such.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like it if we could get to know each other better so that you can choose me with confidence next time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's coming from THE Haruka Kiritani! I'm so jealous! But more importantly...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
Thanks again for inviting me here today. Between the park and your show, I had a ton of fun today♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. We even got to go on some of the rides we missed last time. However, I feel a bit guilty about having the star of today's show act as our guide...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, as far as I could see, she wanted to show us around. Isn't it fair to say that it was one of her birthday wishes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm glad we got to visit PXL again! It's always way too much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And again, Kohane, happy birthday!
Let's keep doing everything we can to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Kohane... You've made such wonderful friends...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
D-Dad, stop...!
Mom, don't just laugh! Do something...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. So many people came to celebrate my birthday today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I have street music to thank for that. I used to be so shy and introverted, but it helped me break free from that little by little...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to do everything I can to keep growing as both An's partner and a member of Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I'll be counting on your support!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry about doing this during practice, everyone, but I took some photos for our flyer and really wanted you to take a look at them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's all good.
It shouldn't take up much time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been looking forward to seeing what kinds of pics you took for us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks!
So... Here they are in digital form.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, this one with the live house's sign in it looks cool. I like the composition you chose for it too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, her broad use of negative space adds a nice dimension to this photo.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I really tried with that one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
See? Isn't Kohane amazing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why are you the one bragging?
Also, quit yammering and start looking through these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What do you guys think?
Would any of these work as a flyer?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I like the one that was taken in front of the live house or the one with the back alley in it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, the one of Vivid Street's really good too, but so is the one with my place peeking it's head out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything you took looks way too good, Kohane! I can't decide at all!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel, Shiraishi.
Each one has a very nice feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Saying, “They're all good,” isn't exactly helpful. It's not gonna help us put any flyers together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, there's something I'd like to ask you. Would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, what would you like to ask?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Each of your photos feature a building as their subject, but they all seem to be taken from a distance. Is there a reason behind that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... This event's supposed to be about everyone who performs on Vivid Street, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I want our flyer to capture that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
