rows.Line: Also, I'm worried that these subjects won't tell the whole or real story... Like I won't be able to capture what's really going on, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The real story...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh... If someone saw a photo of me with no background in it, they probably wouldn't get a good idea of who I really am...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if I were to take it in my room, they'd have a better idea since they'll see all the PXL merch and photos I took decorating it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That makes sense. It brings a person's individuality and other traits to the surface.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's so cool, Kohane!
I didn't realize you put so much thought into these!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it's just... My dad always tells me to figure out what I really want to take since where a photo's taken and in what situation are so important.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Vivid Street in particular has an incredibly unique feel to it, so I want to make it so people see that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, this place has a certain warmth or smell to it that you can't find anywhere else!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you're trying to say. Singing somewhere else just isn't the same as singing here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you call it...? The air...? The atmosphere...? No, that isn't any different from the feel of this place...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I'm having trouble coming up with the right word as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I believe that your photos capture the very essence of what we're struggling to describe, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, Kohane, you really are the best! What if you end up becoming a professional photographer?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! Th-There's no way I could become a pro. My dad's the one who taught me all this and he just does it for fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Moreover, I think I'm able to take photos like this now because of my practices with Taiga.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Uncle Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. For instance, Taiga showed me how there's only one way from Vivid Street into the back alley in this photo.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, this alley! It's the shortcut we always take to go to Weekend Garage from the live house on the street that's one block down.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we've been using it a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we have. It's narrow and a bit difficult to navigate, but it's always fun to see all the graffiti that people have drawn on the walls.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly! Taiga showed me all these spots that give off that unique Vivid Street vibe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now I get it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you put this much thought into these pics, I kinda think we should have a bit more of a serious discussion as to which to choose.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad you feel that way, but we still need time to practice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I'm sure we'll still have plenty of time for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Also, our flyer's gonna play a big role in how we get the word out about our event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Definitely. We're going through all this trouble, so we should try to make a flyer that also tries to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're raising the bar way too high.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, I'm not!
Kohane can do it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll do my best to put a good flyer together!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm never gonna get tired of looking at this. You made such a good flyer, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's all you've been saying for a while now, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because it really is an amazing flyer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At first glance, it looks pretty simple, but the picture, the lettering and the colors all have this way of drawing your eye.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sure some people are gonna want to come see our event because of this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
A cafe mocha topped with plenty of whipped cream and honey.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow! This looks so yummy!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Dad, check this out!
Here, this is the flyer for that event we're gonna do!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, it's done?
Let's have a look.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What do you think...?
This design's so good that it might actually hold up a candle to RAD WEEKEND, right?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see. A simple but tasteful design.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Most of the flyers people ask me to put up usually have flashier or more colorful designs.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was a little concerned about that at first too, but Akito was really against making it too in your face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, you mentioned that you wanted to try using as few colors as possible too, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. My goal was to use only some accent colors since I chose a black-and-white photo for the background.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see. By giving it a more subdued design, it ends up standing out from its flashier counterparts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we also talked about using the flyer for RAD WEEKEND as a reference, but we didn't end up actually coming to look at it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. As cool as that flyer looks, I sort of didn't want to copy it too much.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The flyer for RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
There shouldn't be any left...
Where did you find that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do we do?!
We can't tell him that we saw it in SEKAI...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh... That came out all wrong!
I meant to say that I drew it to show them what it more or less looked like!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway!
We can put up our flyer inside our store, right? Also, it might be nice to put one up on the wall or something.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, go for it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! I'm gonna go get the poster tape. I'll be right back, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: By the way, can I ask you something...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! U-Um, the flyer for RAD WEEKEND was really just...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha. Relax, that's not what I had in mind. I want to ask about your guys' event flyer.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: This photo you used. Is this somewhere on Vivid Street? I vaguely remember seeing some of these things, but I've been having trouble putting my finger on any of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, that's a photo of Vivid Street, but I shopped together a few of them for the flyer.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Shopped? You know how to do that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I had my dad help me a lot with that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see... I'm guessing there's a reason behind you putting so much thought into this and going out of your way to ask for your father's help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, initially, I was planning on just using some photos I'd taken of Vivid Street...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But An and the others began coming up with keywords for the event and I thought to myself, “This won't be enough.”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It wouldn't be enough?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Our goal is to surpass RAD WEEKEND, the event you and your team put together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why we want to create something that no one has ever seen before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This flyer represents a part of that goal.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
Something no one's ever seen before, huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
That's a good concept.
I hope your event goes well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, I'm back!
Where do you wanna put up our flyer?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Probably somewhere everyone can see it, right? Like the doorway or one of these walls?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, we can put one on Dad's back too!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I don't mind. While you're at it, you should put one on your back to advertise whenever you help out around here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Our flyer's cool, but that seems like a bit much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, it might look good as a t-shirt.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, you all done practicing today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and we decided to stop by.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, the back should be open right now, so feel free to take it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you.
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew, I'm starved.
I might just ask for a sandwich.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, won't it be time for dinner by the time you get home?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's true...
But I feel like I can scarf down a sandwich and dinner right now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on... Your shoot's tomorrow, isn't it? You sure about eating so much the day before?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hahaha.
Are you saying that she won't fit into her dress?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, there's no way I can possibly gain that much weight overnight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I see your guys' point, I'll hold off for now... I mean, I wanna go into that shoot in the best condition possible!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, here are the drinks you ordered. It's important to rest, but don't stay out too late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, do you have to get up early tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, not that early.
The chapel for the shoot isn't that far away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I'm sure you'll be fine, but please let us know if anything happens. You never know. We may be able to help if you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
If anything happens...?
You want us to get wrapped up in another wedding?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what if something does happen...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha... Let's hope everything goes okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Did you guys take any photos when you were a part of that flash mob a while back?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did!
When we returned to the hall after our show was finished, the bride asked us to take some pictures with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone had very nice smiles on their faces too since our show went so well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we don't have much of a story to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You want to hear about our little shoot, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah.
I was hoping to hear something that might help us with our shoot tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... However, as Akito said, we don't have much information to give you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All we did was take some pictures to celebrate. It's not like we were modeling for anything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, your dad's always taking tons of pictures of you, so aren't you used to being in front of the camera?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
The thing is...
That's sort of just what he does...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And he's family, so it doesn't ever feel like I'm his model or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I see what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh oh... I'm starting to get kind of worried about this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we've never modeled for anything before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But thinking's just gonna make us worry more. I say we just buck up and give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, what if you tried looking at this from the perspective of the person behind the camera instead of in front?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you'll have an easier time preparing yourself mentally if you understand what the photographer's hoping to capture...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If I were to take photos of An in a wedding dress...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-If I was the photographer, I think I'd want to see you smiling, An...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, smiling is certainly important.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I think you'd have more than a few problems if the bride wasn't doing that while wearing a wedding dress...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right.
Sorry, I know it sounds really simple.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, Kohane, I really appreciate you trying!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This Ms. Kawasaki's a professional photographer, right? I'm sure she'll figure something out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! We can just do our best and learn what we can from her while making sure not to cause too much trouble!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Let's give it our best shot!
Outside the wedding hall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Congratulations, An!
You getting married really brings a tear to my eye...!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And close it out by really squeezing her tight!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Th-Th-Thank you, Airi!
I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... S-So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, Kohane, go get her!
This might be your last chance ever to hug her!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-My last chance...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But... Noooo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wah! Ko-Kohane... You're crushing me!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Everyone, let's move to our next location!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was nervous at first, things went really well because of Airi and An...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to keep this up and keep trying my best!)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! We should get the bouquet out since we're out in front of the chapel!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: The ring and veil too. They should be in the waiting room, so let's go and get them.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Right.
Everyone, please take a quick break while you wait for us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, hey. Why don't we take this opportunity to take some pics of ourselves? I wanna send some to my dad and our teammates.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your teammates? You're talking about Akito and Toya, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, they're probably practicing on their own right now, so I wanna let them know that things are going smoothly here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so nice.
Alright, why don't I try taking a photo of all of us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, you're volunteering? Despite being not exactly the best at this sort of stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't give me that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you and your phone not get along very well, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I'll volunteer since I really like photography!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You will? Great, thanks!
Here, Shizuku, stand next to An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, the timer's set...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, good! It turned out pretty well!
I'll send it to all of you a little later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...and I just sent it over to our group chat!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This should surprise Akito. I mean, we have Shizuku and Airi modeling alongside us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it will.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
There's something I've been meaning to ask...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Kohane, you go to Miya Girls, but you and the others go to Kamiyama High, right, An? How did you all meet in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow. So you got a little lost, found the cafe An's dad runs totally by accident and that was when you two met?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, and I asked Kohane to sing with me after I felt this big jolt run through me when I heard her sing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow, that's like something out of a TV show♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! It felt like destiny and an opportunity I'd never get ever again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, you're blowing things out of proportion.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I really don't think I am!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, so you four weren't always singing together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we were separate teams in the beginning. Then, by chance, we got to sing together and it went amazingly well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, you two already knew Akito and Toya, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, in my case, Ena... Akito's sister and I were in the same class during junior high for a while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I went over to her house a few times and that was when I met him.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As for me, Airi introduced him to me during the Summer Festival while mentioning that he's Ena's younger brother.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Akito's also pretty mature. So much so that I sometimes wonder who's actually the older sibling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderfully close to my situation since Shii's also a very mature girl.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What part of that are you calling wonderful?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I haven't had a chance to talk to Akito's sister. I've only ever greeted her in passing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Same. I hope we get a chance to actually talk sometime.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And Akito's gonna have that sour look on his face when we try to.

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
We got all the props ready!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, what a beautiful bouquet.

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Hehe. I had this really talented florist make it for us just for today.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Would you all mind if I gave a quick rundown of this scene before we start?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Deep breath... Okay!
Let's pick back up where we left off!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! Let's do our best, An!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait, Kohane!
We had a lot more customers than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
We still have plenty of time until the doors open for the event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank goodness. That means all we have to do now is meet up with Akito and the others and perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, that reminds me. Do you have any albums with photos of you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I'm sure we do at home somewhere, but what's this all the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You told us that story the other day from when you were little, right? I was hoping to see what you looked like back then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally.
I'll try looking for some when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you so much, An!
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are!
Kohane, over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here you are! These are the albums you asked for the other day!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, this is more than I was expecting! Hang on... One, two... Five?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. I was surprised too.
But you'll see why there are so many once you start flipping through them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? In that case, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Knock yourself out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, here's one with you and Ken. And this one... Is this your mom?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's her!
Also, Aunt Nagi's the one who took this picture.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, you guys all seem so close!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, the next page has photos of Nagi and Taiga. Also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? This man in the hat...
He seems awfully familiar...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, can you guess?
That's actually the manager of the live house from yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The person next to him is the old manager of RED, the live house we performed at the other day. And...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...which is why we have so many albums. There're as many photos of our family as there are of people from around town.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I really had no idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Going through all these albums kinda made me see why Aunt Nagi said she loves everyone from around here so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They're all really nice and friendly...
And, well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Comforting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's exactly it!
How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. The photos with you and Nagi made me think that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, there was a point where your mom stopped showing up in these photos.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that was probably when she started going back to work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No one was usually home back then, so I was usually with Aunt Nagi and everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looking back, I guess I wanted my dad and Aunt Nagi to pay more attention to me since it was so lonely not always having my mom around.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I haven't felt lonely at all since that time I decided to run away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got to know how Aunt Nagi and my dad really felt about me, and...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: Good luck with practice today, An!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line: I love the way you sing, An♪

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: I have a song that I'd like to recommend. Would you like to hear it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know that I have everyone from around town on my side....

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So as long as I'm here, I'll never be alone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This really is a wonderful city.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now I totally get why Aunt Nagi said she'd never get tired of this place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I want you to keep loving this city too, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I will. I love this city a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because it's where I met you and got into street music. This place means so much to me now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: K-Koohaanee...!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wah! A-An!
You always throw yourself at me like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because what you said made me so happy.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay... Another day spent singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah... Wait, huh?
It's still light out?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: According to the clock, we were over there for about three hours.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It always feels like we get a lot done whenever we practice with Miku and the others. A couple hours can seem like half a day, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Now, since we have some time on our hands, wanna head over to my place for a break?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on!
Can we go for a quick walk around the city?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Around the city?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! We have to “take a look at this city”, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that we'll learn something if we look around as much as we can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me of how you and Uncle Taiga spent a bunch of time walking around town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember hearing that too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I agree that thinking alone probably won't get us anywhere. Actually going for a look might give us some new leads.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also curious as to why you and Taiga went for a walk during practice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's try going on the walk you and Uncle Taiga went on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, do you remember what route you guys took?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I still remember!
We started at a ramen shop at the end of Vivid Street!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... We came to this ramen shop after stopping by that record store.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's a different one compared to where we started.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Does Taiga like ramen that much or something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounded like he used to eat ramen all the time when he was younger and came here pretty often.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This shop's famous for its pork broth and miso ramen, but he likes to get the fried rice with ankake sauce.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I remember!
The boss kept telling Uncle Taiga, “You've gotta try my best dish at least once!”

rows.Speaker: Boss
rows.Line: Hm? Well if it isn't An and Vivid BAD SQUAD. I thought I heard some familiar voices.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hi.
We were just taking a stroll around town!

rows.Speaker: Boss
rows.Line: Hahaha! You guys really like hanging out with each other, huh? Just like Ken and Taiga back in the day.

rows.Speaker: Boss
rows.Line: Also, I'm about to add a new menu item soon. Don't forget to stop by for a taste!

rows.Speaker: Boss
rows.Line: Here, take this flyer. Bring it next time to get half off your next meal!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Half off?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, awesome!
Alright, we'll try to stop by the next chance we get.

rows.Speaker: Boss
rows.Line: Great! I'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, next... We stopped by here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The greengrocer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I was sorta expecting to see a live house or two by now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this place closes at 8:00 pm, so you can get a lot of stuff really cheap around 7:30 pm!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do we really need to know that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! It's absolutely essential if you live around here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi! Is Grandma here today?

rows.Speaker: Greengrocer Lady
rows.Line:
Oh, An, hello.
Sorry, she's seeing the chiropractor today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no! Is she okay?

rows.Speaker: Greengrocer Lady
rows.Line:
No, she's fine.
A friend of hers is in town and she just went over to chat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, thank goodness!
I was worried that she wasn't.

rows.Speaker: Greengrocer Lady
rows.Line: There's nothing to worry about! She may look like a granny these days, but she's always saying how young she feels.

rows.Speaker: Greengrocer Lady
rows.Line:
Be sure to stop by again soon.
We're going to start selling the chilled pineapples like we do every year.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Chilled pineapples?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You haven't heard of them? They're ice-cold pineapples that are cut into sticks!

rows.Speaker: Greengrocer Lady
rows.Line: We're very proud of our pineapples, so please stop by to try them. Grandma and I will be waiting right here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We will! Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, that seems to be about everything you and Taiga saw...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But we didn't really learn much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we learned about that fried rice with ankake sauce, how we can buy cheap produce and chilled pineapples.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm actually looking forward to trying some of those pineapples.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we've gotta grab a few sometime!
And she wasn't here today, but Grandma's a super nice person!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we get it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, you seemed to really enjoy this walk from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You were smiling the whole time as you told us about all these things that only the locals would know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it was kinda like having my friends over at my house.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had so much fun that I totally forgot about our main goal!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We didn't get many insights into what it means to “take a look at this city”... But we got a taste of just how welcoming this city is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. The boss of the ramen shop and the greengrocer lady were so nice too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, we need to think more about what it means to “take a look at this city”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Considering how much it's puzzling Tono, finding an answer won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's work together and do our best to find the answer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Kohane.
KAITO and Rin are hanging out back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Kohane, we've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's have another great day of songwriting!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm really looking forward to working with you two again, Rin, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to be so formal with us. Let's try to have fun while we work, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, did you get a chance to try your hand at some sampling?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I decided to use An's song as the base and tried a few different things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I couldn't really tell if it turned out okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, would you mind listening to it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-How was it...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought it was good!
You came up with some very interesting phrases for this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means we can get down to nuts and bolts!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I'm still a little worried about the phrase and things I used...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, are you concerned that you didn't do them justice?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I really don't think there's anything to worry about. I mean, there's no real right answer when it comes to sampling...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ugh. KAITO, don't kid around!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane's being serious, so you should be giving her concerns more consideration.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. I thought I was being serious.
At least, more than when I teach you and the others, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! Hang on! What's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Whoa, I was just kidding!
Please don't shake me like that! I'm going to get nauseous!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Rin...!
P-Please, calm down...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
KAITO, Rin, knock it off.
You're upsetting Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But KAITO was all...!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Rin, Kohane, here are your drinks.
KAITO, you don't get one.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww, but...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I finally got to have some coffee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I sort of can't do without it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Kohane, what did you feel during your attempt at sampling?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I started by listening to An's song and wanted to capture that heart-pounding sensation I felt when I heard it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I like it so much that I ended up using almost all of it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, almost all of it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, but that sort of defeats the purpose of this exercise, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I listened to it over and over again, and chose all the parts that I thought were absolutely necessary. That's what I had you listen to just now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. It sounds like you had quite a lot of fun with this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's the case, Kohane, I think you're doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...? I am...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Remember our discussion about songwriters being very meticulous creatures?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what do you think it means to be “meticulous”?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's simple!
You just have to have a clear image of what you want to do in your mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's all?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I definitely got the sense that you firmly know what you want to do, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The truth is... What I felt when I met An for the first time, my desire to thank her for inviting me to form a team, the joy I feel just standing next to her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
She's given me so much.
I want to convey just how exciting things have been for me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, that's great!
I can't wait to hear that song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me neither. I'll definitely want to hear it as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, Kohane, keep in mind that your feelings and the song you want to create lay within you and only you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thus, it's up to you to give it form and bring it into this world.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Within me only...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're right. I made the decision to do this, so I'm going to go through with it! I have to push my worries aside!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, KAITO, Rin, I'm going to try my best! And I'll be looking forward to working with you two!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! Kohane's so fired up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, she is. And don't forget to have fun along the way as you take on this new challenge.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Nice work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, nice work. Just make sure to practice what we discussed on your own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Akito and I are gonna work on making some small fixes to our new song. Toya, Kohane, wanna stop by the cafe for a little break?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry...
There's something I need to attend to today again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, okay. How about you, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As much as I want to go...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, I also need to go do something...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you too? That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm really sorry, but thanks for the invite.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, that's all good!
In that case, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! See you tomorrow!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, finished!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, we were assigned so much homework today... But I'm glad I go through it all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is usually when I go to bed...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But maybe I can stay up a little longer since we don't have practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... Where did I leave off last time...? I think I was entering in this beat...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to finish the thing I was working on... But... Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get really sleepy...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
N-No, I can't fall asleep yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wake up...! Wake up...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hello! Rin told me that you wouldn't be coming over to SEKAI today. How's work...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It needs to sound...cooler...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You stayed up so late. Sleep tight, Kohane...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hey, KAITO, why'd you leave me behind like that?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Wah! Rin, quiet!
Look...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hm? Oh, Kohane's asleep...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's very late and I'm guessing she had practice earlier, so we should let her rest.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, like this? Won't she catch a cold?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. In that case...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hello, Kohane? Wakey-wakey.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Kohane, you're gonna catch a cold if you don't sleep in your bed.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's very late, Kohane, so you should stop what you're doing and get in a good night's sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Okay, Mom...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <M-Mom?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Haha! She's still half asleep!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good night...

rows.Speaker: Rin & KAITO
rows.Line:
<Nighty night.>
<Good night.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. Do you think she'll remember what just happened after she wakes up tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Who knows?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <For now, sleep tight.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We'll see you later, Kohane.>
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone from the promo and maze teams, thank you for your patience!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The costume team will now be doing a little fashion show and photo shoot to take promotional pics for our haunted house!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Classmates
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get why everyone's excited, but the promo team can't seem to contain themselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We heard that the costumes turned out really amazing, so we can't wait to see them!

rows.Speaker: Promo Team Member A
rows.Line: Also, getting to take pictures of them means our work's just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, so...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we only have the costume for one wolf and Little Red Riding Hood's hood ready...

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line: Are these really gonna be enough?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yup! We have the trees Shiho and her team made, so these should be more than enough!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, Shiho, can we borrow some of your trees?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course. We had a feeling that you guys would need them, so we made sure to get them done the day before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much! That helps a lot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ahem. Now then!
We'll start with the costume for Wolf #1!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa! It looks so real!

rows.Speaker: Promo Team Member B
rows.Line: Yeah. I was kinda wondering how it'd turn out at first after I heard that they were making it out of cardboard and a helmet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same. I can't believe how realistic it is.

rows.Speaker: Scarer Student A
rows.Line:
This is awesome, costume team!
How did you guys make this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we used a helmet and some cardboard to put the face together. Once that was done, we draped some cloth over it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we gave it some eyes, ears and fangs! And voila, it was done!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, this wolf is meant to be not so scary for those who aren't exactly thrill seekers. As such, the eyes are meant to look kinda cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, the way they're drooping a little's kind of cute!

rows.Speaker: Scarer Student B
rows.Line: I agree. Even if you ran into it, you could probably just say hi to it and walk away.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. An should be able to enjoy this sort of haunted house.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'll start taking some photos now!
Also, if you don't mind, could you put it on and pose like you're trying to scare someone?

rows.Speaker: Scarer Student A
rows.Line: Okay! Lemme try putting it on!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member A
rows.Line: We'll help! First, you need to look for the zipper on the back... Here, it's this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You tried to make the cloth look like a wolf's fur, right? Are you sure about using just gray for that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I see what she means... I think wolves have white fur around their mouths. A lot of dogs too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you need fabric paint, you can borrow some from the maze team.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shiho!
I probably didn't realize sooner because Samo's all white!

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks, Hinomori! We should be able to get it to look even more wolflike now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank me.
It was just something I happened to notice.

rows.Speaker: Costume Team Member B
rows.Line:
Still, good eye.
Wait, Hinomori, do you like animals...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? It's not like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Shiho really loves adorably fluffy, little bunny rabbits that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A-Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why are you giggling, Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just... You're so cute, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? You sound like my sister...

rows.Speaker: Promo Team Member A
rows.Line:
Kohane! Everyone!
She's done putting on the wolf costume! Let's start taking some pictures!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please make a really, really amazing flyer for us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You all worked really hard on making these, so I promise to make something really good with the promo team!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ...and the night festival was really fun because I got to watch my friend's band play alongside my classmates!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
It sounds like the School Festival turned out to be quite an event.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still... Not being able to take that wolf's head off must've been terrible. I'm glad you didn't get hurt during all that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too. I was fine in the end...
But I sort of caused a lot of people a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That wasn't your fault, Kohane!
It was my fault for getting scared and running away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Guh... Hey...
You could try to cheer me up a little, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, what you said is actually true. Why do I need to say otherwise?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so sorry, An. I really didn't mean to scare you like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also need to apologize to you too, Shinonome, Aoyagi. I'm sorry for leaving you two behind that time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. We honestly didn't have any idea what was going on then, so there was no way either of us could've stopped either of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito even said how he probably would've been able to help a little if you didn't look like a dog...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A-Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we can't change what happened. So, it's fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what did you two do while Kohane chased after An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's a good question...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We started looking for you two since neither of you would pick up your phones.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right... You guys did call us a bunch of times...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sorry. I really had no idea...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You didn't notice even when Rin was there with you? You must've been desperate to find An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, even if you did pick up, you probably weren't in a state to hold an intelligible conversation...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we wandered around your school looking for the two of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was when we ran into Momoi and Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We found them in the courtyard advertising what their class was doing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After speaking to them, we decided to have some of what they were offering.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what did they make...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Lookalike sweets.
Minori, Shiho and I went over on the first day and tried a lot of different things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Lookalike sweets...?
That sounds interesting. Care to explain further?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They had some that looked like sushi but it was really chocolate. There was also a steak that was actually bread.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They also had pot sticker cookies too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I felt so confused while eating them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My eyes saw a pot sticker, but my tongue was telling me that it was a cookie.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can see why your brain would've been so confused.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I'm really glad that you were both able to enjoy the festival together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. After that, we wandered around searching for Azusawa and Shiraishi while soaking in the atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we had another look around after meeting back up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?!
So we didn't need to feel that sorry after all?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Didn't I say not to worry?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
By the way, did you take any pictures?
I'd like to see what it was like if possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane took tons.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I did!
Where would you like to start?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well... Why don't we start with what this zombie wolf An ran from looked like?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to see just how scary it was.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
B-Brace yourself, MEIKO!
It's super duper scary!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We practiced singing for much longer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Get home safe, okay, you guys?
You especially, Kohane, since you're such a cutie.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An, I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, see you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An, Kohane, Toya & Kotaro
rows.Line:
Bye!
Okay.
See you!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
What's with Akito?
We're all headed the same way, aren't we? Why's he not coming with us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suspect that he wants to run all the way home...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, seriously...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That's Akito for you.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Th-The rest of us are all just walking home, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's the plan.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, you guys look after Kohane for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An...
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I feel more tired than usual today. I was only planning on placing a reservation for my little brother's Christmas present too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, quite a lot did happen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Shinonome in particular had a very busy day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also... That story about Crawl Green really took me by surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too... I had no idea that such a thing happened before we formed our team.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So you guys heard...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When I started singing here, I remember Shinonome being such a good singer who knew how to get an audience going...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But he must've practiced so much in order to attain that ability... He must've suffered so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Maybe that's why...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I was reminded of something he said when I first started singing with An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you're saying practicing hard is the same thing as having resolve? Don't make me laugh!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're absolutely serious. We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Can you say the same thing, shrimp?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The music world isn't a place you can just come waltzing into like you're on some field trip.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa...
He really said that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When Azusawa performed in her very first event...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for what happened that time. I wish I could've stopped him somehow...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hold up...! I remember now! That was when the plug literally got pulled on you and the whole event got ruined, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Which means it was actually my fault. I'm so sorry for what happened!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay...!
It doesn't bother me at all anymore.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, Shinonome wasn't wrong about what he said...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Back then, I definitely didn't fully comprehend what it meant to surpass RAD WEEKEND or what it would actually take.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What he said shocked me, and I thought I wasn't good enough...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if he hadn't said that, I probably wouldn't have taken a hard look at what I was doing. Singing and chasing after the same dream as An...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And just now I realized something...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that Shinonome said what he said to me because he knew what it meant to sing here. He knew better than anyone else how you need to be determined to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Which is why I think...
It was his way of being kind...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm not sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I may be wrong, but he doesn't seem like that nice a person.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito did get very emotional that time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, what he told us about today may be at the source of why he said what he said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place has come to accept us, but it's also constantly testing our abilities.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
Still...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I decided to sing here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I as well.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Same here! So, let's all surpass RAD WEEKEND together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whew...!
This seems like a good place to stop for today.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We were doing pretty well just now. I'd like to stay for a little longer if that's okay with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, we can't today...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We actually need to go buy Christmas presents for some friends of ours.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Ah, then please go...
I hope you find some good gifts for them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you. We hope so too!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, let's find some good gifts for Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka said that we'll need them for the bingo tournament, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We also need to make sure they can't see what's inside. Apparently, each time a person gets a bingo, they'll choose a present from the pile.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means we have no idea who's going to get what. So, we probably shouldn't try to find presents that are meant specifically for Len or whoever else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Actually, that could be fun.
We don't know who these presents are gonna go to, so it'll be interesting to see who gets what in the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since finding presents that everyone is going to enjoy will likely prove difficult...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I agree. Anyway, let's head in and start browsing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Trinket Shop

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An, look...!
You can wrap this bear plushie to your arm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's so cute!
We should totally get one of these!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on... What happens if KAITO gets that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
He might actually like it.
I can already see him saying, “Haha! I have a new partner now!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Heh... He actually might.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? So, that's one down♪
Toy Store

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
This is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Everyone, look.
They have a cotton candy machine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, I haven't seen one of those in so long! My dad and I used to make cotton candy all the time with an older version of this machine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It looks like a toy, but it really does make cotton candy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, let's get one of those.
Rin and Len might like it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm...? What do you have there, Akito? Are those shoes with springs...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, those are Hopper Kings!
Talk about a blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hopper Kings...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, those shoes allow you to jump really high when you put them on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you need to be pretty athletic to get them to work...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Miku and the others seem to be able to dance pretty well, so that shouldn't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And they're one size fits all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, any foot length up to 30 cm.
That should cover most users.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's keep this up and find presents for all six of them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice! That's something for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We had so many options to choose from, but I think we picked out a good selection.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. All that's left is to see who gets what.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Especially that bear plushie you can wrap around your arm.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Personally, I wanna see KAITO get it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it'd look really cute on Miku or MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally! They're usually the cool and mature ones, but it might be nice to see them wear something adorable like that for a change!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Now I'm really looking forward to our Christmas party!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
Taiga had me do a lot again during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When he asked me to do animal impressions, I didn't expect to get so serious about it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Grrr... Woof!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: No, don't try to express yourself using words. Remember, humans and animals produce sounds in very different ways...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right. Uh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We humans speak by using our tongues and lips to alter the sounds produced by our vocal cords. Animals on the other hand simply produce sound from their throats.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (From their throats...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: GRRR... WOOF!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, that was pretty good.
Alright, now try doing an elephant.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An elephant?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Tricky, right?
So, how are you going to tackle this one?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Okay...
Why don't we call it here for today?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, aren't you heading over to Ken's place after this? In that case, your homework will be to keep doing animal impressions until you get there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You can choose any animal you like. However, you need to speak as them, not just impersonate their sounds.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Speak? As an animal...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is really embarrassing...
But this is practice, so I need to keep trying!)

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, it's Vivi... She's coming towards me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, maybe she can help me with this. She's a real cat, so I might be able to use her voice as reference.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Alright, I'll start by greeting her...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Meow! Purr, meow...!
(Hello! Nice weather today!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Huh? She tilted her head.
Maybe she didn't understand what I was trying to say... I'll give it another try!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Meow! Purr, meow...!
(Hello! Nice weather today!)

rows.Speaker: Vivi
rows.Line: Meow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, Vivi responded! Does that mean she understood me? Okay, I'll keep trying to talk to her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane!
What are you and Vivi talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh no... What do I do...?
As much as I want to talk to her, I'm supposed to talk like an animal until I get to An's place...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Sorry, did I scare you that bad?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Meow, meow.
(Sorry, An.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me-Me-Meow, meow, meow...
(Taiga asked me to talk like this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh no... Th-That's way too cute...!!!
Kohane, what's going on? Why are you talking like a cat?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Sh-She didn't understand me at all!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wait, of course she doesn't understand...
I should just explain things to her normally...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But that would take away from my practice...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga's always asking me to do the strangest things, but they've all had some sort of positive effect.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which means this exercise should also ultimately help me. He told me over and over again to focus on using my throat better, so I just need to keep at that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to see this through until the end!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still have no idea what's going on, but you seem to be taking this really seriously...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I'm also gonna try my best to decipher what you're saying! Would you mind repeating what you just said?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Meow!
(Okay!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Thank you so much, An!
I'll try my best too...!)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...is what happened.
It was seriously the cutest thing ever!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, it's one thing for Kohane to just do as she's told without asking any questions, but you going along with her still doesn't make any sense...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I'm impressed.
You eventually managed to explain how Taiga asked you to do that for practice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course she did!
I mean, she's the best partner ever!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Still, animal impressions...
I'd heard some people do vocal training like that before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's apparently a way to make your vocal cords more flexible because you use muscles you normally don't. As a result, you're able to express yourself in more ways.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, why don't we give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya...
You just want to make animal noises, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's a part of it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's give it a try!
Kohane, I'll try copying an animal this time, so can you give me some pointers on how?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Here it is...
I got lost in these back alleys the first time I visited this area.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This seems like a good place for me to start for a stroll down memory lane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I'll choose this for my first photo...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, Taiga?
Can I try taking photos again for practice?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I sang at Crawl Green the other day, I finally began to understand why you took me around to all those different places.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I want to return to the places I went to the first time I came here as a way of revisiting those memories.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When I wandered into this place for the first time, I felt so scared because of all the graffiti on the walls. I didn't even have the courage to ask for directions...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But, it's thanks to getting lost that time that I found Weekend Garage and met An.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that turned out really well!
I'm going to keep taking more.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (When I went down this street for the first time, it felt like I was entering a whole new world.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But now, I feel at ease because I know where I am and where I'm going...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this is where An and I did our first street performance!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was so nervous that time, but An started singing first and everyone began clapping along. After that, I had no trouble singing and really enjoyed myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This city's full of people who love music...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (After I began performing in events by myself to gain experience, more and more people began recognizing me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which seems to mean that they've been watching over me since I first came here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All the people he and An helped me meet and make personal connections with... As well as Taiga himself and An's dad...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all want to hear me sing, and I want to them to hear me sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This feeling. I can see how important it is when it comes to singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As I move forward, I need to keep everything that I experienced and realized in mind as I sing...)

rows.Speaker: Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Hm? Well, if isn't Kohane.
Are you all by yourself, today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um. Yes.
I was taking some photos as a part of singing practice...

rows.Speaker: Store Clerk
rows.Line:
For singing practice...?
Oh, the lady from the record store mentioned that to me in passing!

rows.Speaker: Store Clerk
rows.Line: You seem to be quite the photographer. Would you mind taking some pictures of me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Thank you very much!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, welcome.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, but An's out buying some stuff right now. She should be back soon, so feel free to make yourself at home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
Oh, would you mind if I took some photos of your establishment?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, for that thing Taiga said. Sure, take as many as you need.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was also really nervous when I came here for the first time. I took a lot of courage for me to just open the door...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But that was when I saw An singing, which got me so excited...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back... Hey, Kohane!
When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Thanks for getting these.
You can take a break for a while now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, you seemed to be staring at the stage just now. Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just recalling what happened the first time I came here. Remember how I asked you to sing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's still crystal clear in my mind because it was the first time I felt so exhilarated after hearing someone sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, what if I did that for you again? Would you like that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then why don't I warm up by singing something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I'm always happy to sing for you, Kohane! Oh, I'll even sing the song I sang that time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Thank you so much, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry, I couldn't help but take your photo just now. This really reminded me of what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. All good!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, lemme get started!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was able to change after discovering Vivid Street and meeting An and all those other people.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I want to keep making music with them.)
Kohane's birthday
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kohane, would you like to join me for lunch?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, sure! Just let me invite Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? I can't spot Minori. I wonder if she's having lunch with Haruka, Airi and Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If that's the case, they might be on the rooftop. Shall we go check?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, okay. If that's alright with you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Well that's new... I mean, Shizuku might be there.)
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah! Kohane and Shiho have arrived!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were waiting for you♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-What? Why are you all here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To celebrate your birthday, of course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ready everyone! 3, 2, 1!
Happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hurray☆
Our surprise worked♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nice work, Shiho. I knew you'd be able to pull it off without her suspecting a thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was nothing. I think we could have even had Minori do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No way! I would've totally freaked out and let it slip accidentally!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sounded way too confident about that just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday Kohane. This is from us, but take care because it's a little heavy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you!
You're right. It is kind of heavy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a Manuka honey set! We often buy stuff from this shop, so I can speak for its effectiveness!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We heard how much effort you put into singing practice every day, so we hope this helps you look after your throat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! I'll be sure to make good use of this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We also take that honey for our throats, but it's so tasty, you'll want to eat more and more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, it also goes great with yogurt and in tea, if you'd prefer to enjoy it that way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? I can't wait to try it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay then! Now it's time for our gift♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon Shiho, hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane.
Here's our gift to you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? C-Could it be?!
It's the new spring limited-edition cherry blossom Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! But it only just came out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
The day it came out, we made a dash for it the moment the bell rung♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was going to buy it on my next day off but was worried they'd sell out since they're so popular. I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Glad you like it. We thought this would be the perfect gift for you, what with you being such a huge PXL fan and all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Despite it being spring-limited, we thought you might have loads of Phennys already.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I may have a lot of PXL merch already, but the seasonal ones are always popular, and there are many I don't have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What's more, the cherry blossom Phenny's design and pose change each year, so it never gets old!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ohhh! Shiho also said the same thing when we decided to get it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Trust a Phenny-lover's instincts!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, all it took was a bit of research...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Since everyone thought each Phenny looked slightly different, Shiho spent ages studying their faces to pick out the best one!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, you don't have to give all the details.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it sounds like you put a lot of thought into it, Shiho. I'll treasure it forever alongside all my other Phenny merch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's still more to come! Now it's time for your Wonderlands×Showtime, gift☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Kohane, watch this video♪
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Happy birthday to our dearest number one fan!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Thank you for coming to see us each time we put on a new show.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Excluding our ambassadorial performances, I have the feeling you've attended every single one of them.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Yes, and we wish nothing but the best for such a fan! And that is why we'll be performing one of our ambassadorial performances—“A Pianist Named Thorpe”—once again at the Wonder Stage!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <We heard from Toya and the others that you were rather distraught at not being able to see it last time, so we decided to let you know once our plans were finalized.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <The performance schedule is now locked in, so you can ask Emu for more details.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <We'll be pulling out all the stops to ensure that our special guest gets the birthday treat they deserve.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Until then, we'll be waiting for you at the Wonder Stage!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Um also, if you're interested, let's practice singing together again...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <We hope you have a magnificent birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wooow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you'll be performing “A Pianist Named Thorpe” again! I heard from Aoyagi and the others that it was really good and I've been wanting to see it since!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. We also want more people to watch it, so that's why we asked if we could perform it again at the Wonder Stage♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll send you the details for the show later☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, thank you everyone for doing so much for my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're happy that we could all celebrate together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Deciding what to get you and shopping for it was also super fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. I hope you had a lovely birthday, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you guys too, Minori, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shiho
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
You're welcome!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Sorry to have kept you waiting. I'm here now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An!
Wait, where are Shinonome and Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They went ahead to Dad's place to get things ready, but said we can take our time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ah, that's right. Mizuki told me to give you this.
Here, it's a hair accessory!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! What a cute hair ribbon! It's so gorgeous... I wonder if it would look good on me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course it would! You're cute, and what's more, Mizuki picked it out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, and I bet Mizuki would be super happy if you sent over a picture of you wearing it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Will do! I'm a little embarrassed to... But I'll send a thank-you message along with it.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hell...oh!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Everything's so beautifully decorated!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, looks like our star of the day has arrived.

rows.Speaker: EVER Members
rows.Line: Hey! Thanks for inviting us to the party.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tono! Oh, everyone from EVER is here too! Thank you all so much for coming.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Well, we do put on events together, and plus An wanted us to come.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Tono. You've still got some decorations to put up. I've already finished my side.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, my bad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? So you guys helped with the decorations too?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We were getting bored just standing around and waiting, so Shinonome made us his errand boys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Making me out to be the bad guy, huh. You're the ones who offered to help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you everyone!
And thank you for doing all this, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, it's your birthday today, so don't go around trying to help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Well if you really don't mind. I'm looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! By the way, where are Toya and Kotaro?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Right here! We've got several freshly-made dishes waiting here, so if anyone's free, we'd appreciate help taking them to the tables!

rows.Speaker: EVER Members
rows.Line: On it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
