rows.Line: Azusawa's already here. Shall we bring out the centerpiece yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Alright! Toya, help me carry it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...
The centerpiece?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, is everyone here now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... I did tell Taiga that there was going to be a party today...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If he can make it then I'm sure he'll be here at some point. Here, would you mind putting these plates on that table?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Got it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, make way! Giant cake coming through!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa, what a huge shortcake!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. Shiraishi made it especially for today. It really is the centerpiece of the table.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you think? Doesn't it look great?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It is, but how did you manage...
Oh! Don't tell me you've been working on this since yesterday?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You got me. I may not have slept much last night, but it's the least I could do for my amazing partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much, An. I'm so grateful!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, you're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ah, and also, the ingredients to make all this food was from friends from around town!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When I told them your birthday was coming up, suddenly everyone started giving me all sorts of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They did that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Like the strawberries on the cake were from the person at the crepe shop and the old lady at the fruit shop! They even said that they'll give us a free treat the next time we visit them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Hehe, then that means I'm going to have to stop by to thank them.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What's this? Looks like the party's barely started.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Taiga, you made it!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yes, well, I couldn't turn down an offer from the birthday girl, could I?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, it seems like everyone we invited is here now, so let's raise a toast!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Great! Please, do the honors!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An's Father & Taiga
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (First my classmates and everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime, and now An and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't believe I got the chance to celebrate my birthday with so many people...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It makes me...so happy!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kohane, thanks for that picture of you wearing the ribbon! You look way cuter in it than I could ever imagine! I hope you keep wearing it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Azusawa. I'm glad you liked the birthday video.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like I said in the video, thank you for always coming to see our shows. It's a joy to have a fan like you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We promise to give it our utmost every day, so you better be watching us with bated breath!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're always welcome to come visit us at the Wonder Stage! Happy, happy, happy birthday to you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane! I'm so glad our little rooftop surprise went well. Thank you everyone for helping out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. We wanted to celebrate Kohane's birthday, too. Many fun and heated debates went into choosing your gift.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We heard how serious you are about singing, so we wanted our gift to be both practical and helpful in a professional sense. Then, we all came up with ideas to consider with scrutiny!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. Kohane, when it comes to self-care, don't hesitate to ask us anything. I'm sure our gift will come in very handy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once again, happy birthday, Kohane. I'm glad we got to celebrate together and surprise you with Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Good thing we made a mad dash for it after school, right, Shiho?♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why're you looking at me? Wasn't it you and the others who suggested the Phenny plushie in the first place?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, that may be true, but you were the one who did a ton of research on Phenny merch, and picked out the one we ended up giving her!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, who wouldn't make sure the recipient actually likes their gift? Anyway, happy birthday, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Azusawa. As Tono and the others said, I'm happy to have helped put this party together and see you enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Seeing your adorable face munching away on that slice of cake was totally worth the all-nighter!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I saw An off to one side watching you with a grin on her face as you dug in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey now. Seeing my partner smile like that was seeing how all my hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! I know I say this all the time, but you are the best partner I could have ever asked for.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know there'll be a lot of hurdles between us and our goal to surpass RAD WEEKEND, but I'll do my best. Someday, we'll all achieve that dream together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My school friends, teammates, and even the locals...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So many people helped put these celebrations together. It's like I'm dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for celebrating my birthday with me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm going to keep doing my best! To surpass RAD WEEKEND and for all of those people who come watch us perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I hope you all continue to support me. Thank you so much for today!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (My practices with Taiga end today...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't know when I'll get to see him again next, so I need to show him how much I've improved with his help!)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, since this is our last practice...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Just show me what you've got, plain and simple. Sing with everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Only Taiga's here to listen, but I'll sing like I did at Crawl Green and...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You said that you wanted to get better. Do you still feel the same way?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
I still want to get better at singing!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, wanna give it a try with me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?
Give what a try?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Well, singing, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want him to hear me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He's taught me so much, and I want him to hear how I sound now...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is everything I have...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
H-How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad.
Nice performance!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It made me think about...STAY GOLDEN, was it?
You sang like there was no tomorrow that time.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You've definitely improved even more since then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But from where I'm standing, you've still got a lot of work to do.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
So, try singing that again for me.
Since this is our last practice together, I'll be as detailed as I can with my criticism.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Please do!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, it's nearly dusk, so let's call things here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is really it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, Taiga...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Ah, lemme stop you there.
I don't want to see any waterworks from you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: This isn't the last you'll be seeing of me, so just act the way you normally do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you for everything you've done for me!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sure thing.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: By the way, is your team free to meet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, about that. The others said they should all be available tomorrow afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry for asking you all on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
They all mentioned how they wanted to see you one last time before you returned to the US.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But at the same time... They were wondering why you asked us all to meet with you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Well, I also wanna see you one last time. I'll explain more tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, see you then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Again, thank you for going out of your way to teach me all these things!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, a message...
It's from An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... Oh, Shinonome and the others are at her place already.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll let her know that we just finished practicing and that I'm heading over now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sent!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's nothing to do...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Normally, we'd all be practicing somewhere together...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's so much I wanted to tell you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to meet Kohane...! And Akito and Toya...! You were supposed to tell me I'd found the best team ever...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you were supposed to see the moment we did it...! When we surpassed RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Tears of sorrow*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We decided to not give up and keep going, but An... I hope she's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The person she loved and looked up to...is gone...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She seemed to be feeling a little better when we left... I wonder if it'd be okay to message her now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Worrying isn't going to fix anything, so I should just...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, a message...!
It's from An!

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry about making you guys worry yesterday. My throat still hurts, but emotionally I'm feeling much better!>

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line: <You guys rest up too since we all put ourselves through the grinder!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
Thank goodness. She does seem much better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, but... She could also be trying not to make us all worry about her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope she really is feeling better...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But if I were to ask how she's really feeling, she'd probably just say she's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do I do in this situation...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, another message...
From Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Message
rows.Line: <If you're trying not to make us worry, please don't. I believe it's okay to put yourself first in these situations.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aoyagi's never afraid of saying things like that... I need to say something too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Thank you for messaging us, An.
You also try to rest since we know you put your throat through a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Also, feel free to let me know if you want to talk. I'll be at home for the rest of today...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Send.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's hard not to dwell on things or let negative thoughts creep in when you're all by yourself... Like I was doing just now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So if she ever wants to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A call...?
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Morning, Kohane.
Surprised?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, a little.
I mean, I just sent my reply to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Haha. You did say that I could call you whenever. So, I called. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I can talk.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Thanks. I was actually just helping open up the cafe. It's really nice out today.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...? You're helping out today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Yeah. My dad said that I didn't have to, but with nothing else to do, I was having trouble getting yesterday out of my head.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was feeling the same way, and I thought that having someone to talk to would take my mind off things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <And that's why you said that we could talk whenever? You really are like the nicest person ever, Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <So, is it okay if we talk until I have to start serving customers?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Wait, no. I need to thank Toya first!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Take your time.
I'm not going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope I can help take her mind off things even just a little.)
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay... I'm pretty sure we only had to do up to this page.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew, I'm all done with my homework! That means I can take it easy tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know! Maybe I'll stop by Weekend Garage since I couldn't make it today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Hey, I'm going to stop by the cafe tomorrow. Will you be there?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And...send.
Oh, she's just seen it.

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line: <Was just about to send you a message! Since I'm helping out, I'll be there from the morning!>

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line: <So, wanna put some time aside for a bit of singing?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll be sure to arrive a bit early while the cafe isn't busy.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Singing practice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We were all practicing together until recently...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: This is it for me.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Goodbye.
This team was fun while it lasted...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'm not gonna lie. This feels like the end of the line...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Why...?! Why...?!
Why couldn't I sing when it really mattered...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Why...?
Why am I such a stupid, spineless piece of garbage...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Just like that... We all split up.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It was a huge shock to us...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But in spite of all that...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I believe you'll figure out a way to get there. The place Nagi wasn't able to reach.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: With your friends here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aunt Nagi placed her faith in me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said she believes that we can carry her dream forward...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna do it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show you guys what things look like from on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An was the one who stepped up and gave us a second wind.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And she must have been hit the hardest by the news of Nagi's passing. She loved her so much...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It just goes to show how amazing An is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No matter what hardships come her way, she just keeps going, facing everything headon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I were in her shoes, would I be able to do the same?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess there's no use thinking of what-ifs. After all, I'm not An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, I should get an early night for tomorrow.
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mmmh.... H-Huh? Why am I in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess I must have dozed off while scrolling on my phone...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... something's glowing. It looks like...some kind of crystal ball?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wah! What's this light?! I can't see!
Vivid Street?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What happened? Am I on Vivid Street?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Does this mean I left SEKAI?
No... I'm not in my room, and it's not even nighttime.

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Hello? You okay over there?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's the lady who works at the record store! That must mean I'm back in the real world, right?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Excuse me! Um... I know this is a strange thing to ask but... This is Vivid Street, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... It's not a trick question! It's just that...

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Hahaha! Hold on a minute, what's gotten into you today?

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: What's with that overly polite tone, An? Kinda caught me off guard!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Did she just call me... An?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Sorry, I'm Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: What're you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: I mean, you sound an awful lot like her, but I'm a hundred percent certain I'm looking at An right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She really thinks I'm An?! B-But...why?)

rows.Speaker: Record Store Lady
rows.Line: Well anyway, feel free to stop by the store whenever. Also, tell the real Kohane I said hi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But... I'm the real Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I should look in a mirror!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Surely not... But, what if...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh! I'll be able to see my reflection in that shop window!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's...definitely me.)

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Oh, well if it isn't An! Aren't you helping out at your ol' man's place today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! Uh... W-Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, I'm not! Dad said I can hang out with my friends today...

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Ahaha, great! By the way, any upcoming events I should know about? You know you can count on me to be in the crowd!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'd love to see you! I'll keep you posted!

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line: Fantastic! Can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I just mimicked An... But, allowing this to blow out of proportion is the last thing I want.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But why is this even happening? Why does everyone think I'm An?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I do now? If only there was someone I could go to for help...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I've got it!
Park?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? An. You're late.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Was Weekend Garage particularly busy?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Judging by their reaction, I'm guessing that they think I'm An, too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Now what? I was hoping that they, of all people, might just recognize me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to keep this under wraps. I don't want them to freak out.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, it was kinda hard to slip away. Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's okay. We understand you have responsibilities. Now we're just waiting for Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She'll be here soon. How about some warm-ups while we wait?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you good to go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... You bet!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay then, let's start.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've got to sing An's part. Okay... Sing it like An would...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's not right...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Her voice has more impact, more strength, more flair...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Stop.
Is it me, or do you sound a bit off?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I could hear it too. Your voice was shaking, as if you were not singing how you wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In particular, your choice of vibrato and breath placement was similar to Azusawa's style.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're right... Actually, your posture, too... You were even standing like her.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Does this mean...they recognized me?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's it! They might realize it's me from my singing style!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (After all...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We practice together day in and day out from dusk until dawn...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And perform at so many events together!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome, Aoyagi, I'm sorry for not saying anything earlier, but... The truth is, I know I look like An, but I am actually Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What're you talking abo—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Allow me to prove it to you...by singing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Please... Believe me! Recognize me!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know that sometimes, I wish I could be like An, radiating with charisma and confidence...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But simply looking like An won't make me happy!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to be myself! After all...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly, genuinely believe that you have an absolutely amazing voice, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time I hear you sing, you make my heart dance and I can't help but want to sing with you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly, genuinely, 100% feel that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We believe in you, Kohane.
Which is why we wanna hear you at your best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm An's partner!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's my own voice that An loves to hear! It's my own voice that she believes in!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to be anyone other than Kohane Azusawa, An's partner!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You... You really are Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! W-Where am I?
...ne! Kohane! Can you hear me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Take a deep breath and listen to me. Kohane, you've wandered into a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A SEKAI formed from...a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Yes. You may have witnessed something yourself, but think of it as an illusion reflecting a deep feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An illusion? So that means Shinonome and Aoyagi weren't real...

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Sorry, Kohane. The fragment is unstable, so I can't go get you. Are you able to get out by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I suppose that means I'll just have to find a way out of this place.

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Will you be alright, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. This place looks like some sort of mirror maze. Good thing all those trips to PXL have given me plenty of experience with these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Miku, you mentioned that this world came from a fragment of a feeling... So, is this someone's SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Yes. But I don't know whose feelings created it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see. I wonder who...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I feel a sort of beauty and warmth here... Like somewhere close to my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Through this mirror, is that...the park that we usually practice in and Weekend Garage?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And there's Vivid Street in that one, and a live house in another...

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Kohane? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... These mirrors are showing me lots of different scenes...and they're all places close to my heart.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Did I just see the others and...my past self?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Hey, that's us on the way home from our first event as Vivid BAD SQUAD...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't know exactly what feelings gave birth to a place like this, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (With every step deeper into the maze, more snippets from my life flash before my eyes then disappear again.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is starting to feel less like a mirror maze and more like a kaleidoscope.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This one with Tono and the others is cracked...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have to keep moving. Miku is waiting for me.
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Glad to see you made it, Kohane. You did well to navigate that by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Miku! I'm so glad that I managed to make it out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What was it like in there? I can only imagine how surreal it all felt.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... There was a surprise around every corner. I felt like I had been whisked away in some dream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's my own voice that An loves to hear! It's my own voice that she believes in!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to be anyone other than Kohane Azusawa, An's partner!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The whole experience helped me to remember something important.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Perhaps it appeared to remind you of that important thing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If that's the case, I owe my thanks to whoever those feelings belonged to.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to be the best partner that An could ever have, and sing by her side forever.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to give up on them.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to get on my feet and give it my all with the others!)
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
The teachers are all in a meeting...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was hoping to talk to them about making it so I'd only have to look after the animals during lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll be late heading over to SEKAI, but I should try again after school.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kohane...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho.
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should be asking you that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It seems like you've had a lot on your mind lately. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I appreciate the concern.
A few things here and there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll be happy to help if you need someone to listen...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, my team and I battled against this really amazing singer who was instrumental in putting on a legendary event that we want to surpass.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you battled against this person?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. He said that there was something we needed to know if we were serious about actually surpassing it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We all did the best we could...
But we couldn't lay a finger on him...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And he sang like he really meant it just for us. It was so incredible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think that was the first time I felt scared after hearing someone sing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He must be the real deal if he made you and your team feel scared, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but we're fine now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because we truly understand now that we won't be able to surpass that event if we don't fully commit ourselves. And we've made our decision.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what lies far beyond that dream.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, I'm glad for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Your band just signed a deal and you're going to be debuting as pros soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We are...
Why do you ask all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
I think it's great how you and your band were able to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you had to overcome a lot of walls and obstacles along the way, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I want to ask what you guys did whenever you ran into one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Walls, huh...?
Yeah, a lot of stuff did happen along the way...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But to be honest, we sort of got lucky and caught a nice wave. I'm not sure we can help much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I really wanna hear about it, as long as you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll just tell it as it is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe we were able to actually go pro because Ichika and the others were willing to commit and put in the work.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Commit and put in the work...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They thought long and hard about what it really means to go pro and how we'll need to look at our music moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Before that, I tried to hold back and play at their level.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But then they surprised me by telling me not to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think that was a result of their commitment.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Looking back, that ended up being a bit of a tough stretch for them. We pretty much spent all of our time outside of school practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even Saki, who loves going to class and really pays attention, got scolded by her teacher after falling asleep.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They really did an amazing job that time. I asked a lot of them, but they figured out ways to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seeing that was proof enough for me that everything comes down to your level of commitment.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As long as you stay committed, even if you get lost or stuck, you'll find a way to stay standing. And as long as you're still standing, you'll be able to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I'm not saying that you guys need more guts or anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess we're not the best example after all...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's not true!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. A strong commitment goes a really long way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There have already been moments up until now when I had to commit myself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we should take another hard look at our dream as a team and reaffirm our commitment to making it come true.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And I'll be rooting for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. I like the expression you just made, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you feel like you can pummel a wall to pieces, why not try giving it a go on that one over there?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! N-No, I wouldn't do anything so violent!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I couldn't sleep and decided to come here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't believe An's dad said he'd start watching our practices.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm doing some cleaning.
I was just putting away all the cups...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Putting them away...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's right. I'm thinking about closing this place down for a little while.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You've all made your decision.
Which is why I'm going to do what I can to honor that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's what I owe you for keeping the truth from you for so long...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't know what our practices are going to be like, but I do know that I'll need to do my best to hang in there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because we told Taiga that we'd surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what's waiting for us beyond that!
You really have changed so much, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, hang on...
D-Did you hear everything I just said...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but I wasn't trying to eavesdrop.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But you heard...!
*Sob*
I feel so embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't be. That was some good determination.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you feeling embarrassed just showed me that some of your old self is still there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My old self...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Back then, I had no confidence in myself, and didn't have any real interests...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A small part of me wanted all that to change, but I was never able to muster up the courage to actually act.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And look at you now, skipping school to give Taiga a piece of your mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know it's not good to cut class...but I don't regret going over to see him one bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Because you didn't want to leave any loose ends.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Remember when you told An and me how this SEKAI is made up of our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I even asked you and MEIKO if this place really is made of “our” feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had to ask because I didn't have a dream like An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now, I can confidently say that I do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My dream is to put on an event with An and the others that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I know for sure now that this is our SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As one who watches over your feelings from this SEKAI, it's wonderful to see you making such big strides.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to see you do more. Much more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're singers, Kohane.
So, let's have our singing do the talking.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tell me how you feel right now. Give me everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, Miku, I want you to listen carefully.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Miku's been by my side this entire time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Whenever I felt like giving up, she was always there to make sure I never lost sight of my true feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Whenever I started losing confidence in myself, she sang with me, encouraged me and pushed me to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I want to tell her...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How much she means to me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And everything I'm capable of with my singing now!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh wow...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Miku's never heard me sing this song before, but we're harmonizing so well!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This must mean that she understands how I feel, and what I'm trying to do with this song.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing really is fun.)
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line: Thank you all for selecting me to be the chair of this committee. I promise to do my very best.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line: Now, I see that we have a mix of both new and returning members here today, but I'd like to take this opportunity to explain the cleanup committee's roles and duties. Firstly...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's such a good speaker, and seems like a really cool senior...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I think Honami said they were on this committee together last year.)

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line:
That concludes my overview.
Does anyone have any questions they'd like to ask?

rows.Speaker: First-Year
rows.Line: Oh, um... You said we're responsible for the flower beds in the courtyard and stuff. But that place is huge...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Yeah, that sounds really hard considering how many flower beds there are...)

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line:
Not to worry.
The school custodian takes care of most of them. We are only in charge of a few.

rows.Speaker: First-Year
rows.Line:
Oh, okay! I'm sorry...
I was worried that I wouldn't be able to spend as much time doing club activities...

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I understand why you'd be worried since I'm also in a club.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Chair
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, why don't we start discussing what kinds of flowers we're going to plant this year...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, Honami was talking about this too...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. Which kinds of flowers should I suggest?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane, what did you think of the cleanup committee?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I was a little nervous at first since I haven't participated in many committee discussions before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Did the animal caretaker committee not have many group discussions?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We gathered in a classroom once to discuss who would be taking care of the animals on what days...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aside from that, we usually gathered by the cages or the shed where all the food and supplies were.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
It makes sense for taking care of the rabbits to take top priority.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. The teachers and more senior members taught me about how to take care of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we never really talked about why our committee exists or anything like that. I had no idea that the cleanup committee would go into so much depth.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ahaha...
The chair does like to take things seriously...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I feel a little bad about making you hear that explanation twice. I basically told you all of it already...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay! It served as a reminder, and now I have all my ducks in a row.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Besides, I'm really glad we got to talk beforehand because I was so nervous during that meeting. I might've missed some things if you hadn't explained things to me earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, thank you for your help.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I feel a little relieved is all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You decided to join the cleanup committee after I told you about my own experiences...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wasn't sure if you'd enjoy it, or if it would become too much of a burden.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I didn't know she'd been giving my decision so much thought.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's such a nice person.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't worry! Yes, I was nervous today, but I'm really looking forward to when we're supposed to meet next.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean, we'll get to plant the flowers that everyone suggested today, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which means we can plant the ones you and I suggested, together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best together, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best as members of the cleanup committee.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane...!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Morning, everyone!
Let's do our best again today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. After all, the practices we do each day mean everything to us now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, the light turned green.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane, I noticed that you're wearing your uniform a little differently now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right. I thought it might be nice to try something new since it's not like our uniforms are changing this year.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, coming up with a new look's really hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was hoping that I could give off a different impression like how you styled it, An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She didn't “style” it so much as just mess it up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, don't go raining on my parade.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, Kohane, which do you prefer?
My old look or my new one?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well... I thought your old look was cool since it felt so clean and tidy. It really suited you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think I prefer your new look since it feels more fun and relaxed. I think it captures you better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A bunch of people in class told me the same thing, but it means so much more coming from you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've gotten Kohane's seal of approval, I'm gonna make the most of my uniform by wearing it as cutely and freely as I can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Freely...?
Says the former hall monitor.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh? I don't think it's that odd. I'm actually impressed by how she followed the rules before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Toya gets it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because I was a hall monitor, I know where the lines are in terms of what's okay and not okay. I plan on enjoying my uniform while following the rules.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Plus, you're on the broadcasting committee now. You'll get to play music by your favorite groups and make your school an even more fun place to be.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
I can't wait to start doing that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What about you, Kohane?
Has the cleanup committee already begun meeting?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we met just the other day and planted flowers in the flower bed together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The cleanup committee's responsible for that at Miya Girls?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's the greening committee's job at our school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: According to our committee chair, it all started after some students who are alumni now decided to help the school custodian with the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The custodian then suggested that they should choose some flowers to plant since it'd probably make things more fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what flowers did you guys plant?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Marigolds and snapdragons.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, great choice!
I love marigolds!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I forget what snapdragons look like. Gimme a sec to search them up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, An, wait...!
You might not want to do that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Because they become kind of scary when they go to seed during the fall...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
S-Scary? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I've read about them in a book before. Apparently, their seed pods form holes in a way that makes them look like little skulls...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, they do look like skulls...
And there's one for every flower. Creepy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why some people became a little worried when they came up as a candidate...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But they spread their seeds in the fall, so we figured that the skulls could work as decorations for Halloween if they were to form at the right time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't you think these look a little too realistic for that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree... They may not be ghosts, but you might want to avoid looking at these, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That only makes me want to look at them even more.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, why not just get it over with?
Boo!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's the big idea?! You're gonna make Kohane's kindness all go to waste!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
The flowers themselves are really cute, so I'll show you some photos of them later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... I've got my indoor shoes, my pencil case, my student ID and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...!
That should be everything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Starting tomorrow, I'm a second-year...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I still don't really feel like one.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I also sort of forgot about school because of how we've started practicing with An's dad.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
I should go over those things we talked about during practice today and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A call?
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello? An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hey, it's me!
Is this Kohane I'm speaking to?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Hehe. Yes, this is Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I felt like talking.
Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Yeah. I was just getting my things together for tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Great! Actually, I should get home soon and start getting all my school stuff together too.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <You're still out?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I was practicing by myself a bit at Weekend Garage. I'm heading home right after I clean up here.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I still need to take a bath and have dinner, but I'm totally ready to fall asleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I actually fell asleep for a second in the tub.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Haha. See what I mean?
Still, we need to be careful so we don't catch a cold or anything.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, tomorrow might be kinda rough. The teachers are gonna get so mad if we fall asleep during the opening ceremony.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <It is supposed to officially mark the start of the new school year.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But I still don't feel like a second-year...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Me neither.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <It's been practice, practice, practice every day lately! I haven't really had time to think about anything else.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <That being said, I'm super excited about my new class! I can't wait to see who's in it!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Me too!
Is there anyone you want to be your classmate?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Well...
It'd be great to be classmates with Mizuki again since we get along so well.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Who else...? Hmm...
You know what? Anyone's welcome in my book!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <It's just like you to say that.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<What about you, Kohane?
Is there anyone you wanna be classmates with?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Me...? Maybe Shiho?
We got to know each other well last year, and we can talk about music. I'd really like to be classmates with her again.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Honami, Emu and Saki would also be nice since we were in the same group when we went to the Seaside School.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <The Seaside School...? Oh, right. Your classes got all mixed up that time.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Yeah. That's why it'd be nice to talk again as classmates.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <And then there's Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <You have been singing and practicing together a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But we haven't really talked about much other than that...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <So, if we were to become classmates, we might get a chance to talk about stuff other than music.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Yeah, you'd definitely get more of those opportunities if you became her classmate.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <You could ask to borrow her pens, have her show you her notes, see if she can give you a better explanation of what happened in class and stuff!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <No, wait. You're the one explaining stuff to others most of the time, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But you're right about getting more opportunities to talk if we do become classmates, An.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Still, what is my new class going to look like?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I really wanna know too.
I'd probably end up lying awake thinking about that if I weren't so exhausted.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Hehe. Me too.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Alright, I'm done cleaning up!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<I'm glad we could talk, Kohane.
Thanks for agreeing to chat so suddenly.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <No, I'm also really glad that we could talk.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Really? Thank goodness!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's both rest up so we don't fall asleep at our opening ceremonies tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Right. Good night.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Night!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was going to practice a little...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I am feeling pretty tired.
I should probably go to bed instead.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I get to see everyone at school tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Kohane.
What can I get for you today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Oh, can I have what I tried the other day? A cafe au lait with honey and cinnamon powder on top?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane, come sit with us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, are you guys not practicing today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, we are in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I decided to take a quick break since I had some time on my hands.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, your school already had its opening ceremony, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, you're officially a second-year now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Have you noticed any changes? You're starting a new year with a new class and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aside from those two things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, the first-years. I have juniors now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right! They'll be looking up to you as their role model!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm not sure how much I'll be talking to them since I'm not in any clubs...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But that's still really cool!
Do you think they're gonna call you by your last name or your first?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. I'm not sure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: During junior high school, I always felt a little anxious whenever my juniors called my name...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? But you're such a nice person, Kohane! I bet everyone's going to love you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so? That'd be nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can you tell us more about your school?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I wanna know more too!
What else has changed for you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What else?
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Settle down, you two.
I know you're happy to see her again, but you shouldn't badger her like that.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: We know!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, Kohane, here's your cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Phew...
Your coffee always has this way of putting my mind at ease, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Well?
Did you think of anything else that's changed now that you're a second-year?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Anything works!
For example, stuff that's different now compared to before!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Exactly!
You just mentioned what happened when you were in junior high! Tell us more about that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now compared to back then...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I wasn't so afraid of walking into my new classroom...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your new classroom?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I always used to get really nervous whenever I was about to enter a new classroom for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mostly because everyone looks at you for a second after you open the door...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was afraid I wouldn't know what to say and worried I wouldn't be able to greet someone back if they tried to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But this time, I didn't feel worried or afraid at all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always hesitated before, but I was able to say, “Good morning,” to everyone pretty naturally.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that means you've grown a lot!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In particular, your courage and confidence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Otherwise, I doubt you would've been able to put on such a stellar performance as the opening act for your event.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We're so proud of you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have started having a little more confidence in myself lately.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it's nice to hear others say that I've actually grown.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, can you tell us more?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, what else has happened?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sure.
Anything in particular?
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to get ready for school tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I'm so sleepy...
Even after taking a nap in the green room...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, wake up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to get ready for tomorrow and take a bath...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Kohane, how are you feeling?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Mom, hi! I'm okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: I didn't get a chance to ask you earlier, but did you have dinner already?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We did. An's dad took us somewhere on our drive home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line:
Still, you got home so late today.
You look exhausted. You must've traveled quite a distance...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, we just went over to Kanagawa.
But our spot in the event lineup was pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Really? So, how did it go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good. I think we all did our best and produced some nice results...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was a battle event, and just about managed to win. Everyone remembers who we are now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm hoping we can keep improving like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Us. Together...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I can tell that you're trying your best, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: I mean, you looked very serious just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't think I'm ever going to find something that I want to do this much for as long as I live.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I want to give it everything I have. Because if I don't, I know I'm going to regret it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know you're worried about me, Mom, but... I want you to let me do this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: I understand. Seeing that you've found something you can work so hard at really puts a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, you coming home late does worry me and your father... But we know that you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: And your teammates and Shiraishi's dad seem like very responsible people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: As your mother, I find peace in knowing that you're being looked after by them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: So, Kohane, for now, do whatever you feel is best for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line: However, please make sure to let me know if you are going to return particularly late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try to be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Mother
rows.Line:
Now, go take your bath.
It should be ready now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay! I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
I feel a little more awake after talking with Mom.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll take that bath, go to bed...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And do my best again tomorrow...!)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back!
*Sigh*
Another day, another exhausting event!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I know it was for practice, but going to Shizuoka and back by car wasn't easy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that sense, I'm guessing Ken's the most exhausted out of all of us...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much for driving us today. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank me.
I'm taking you to all these places because I think it's necessary for your training.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Also, I like going out for long drives.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that reminds me.
Dad, you used to drive us everywhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember going camping in the mountains, doing a barbeque by the beach and a bunch of other stuff. A lot of good times.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun.
It's always nice to go to those kinds of places to get a breath of fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but where we went today also had that sort of effect. I thought what we saw was very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mount Fuji, tea fields and so much more... I had a lot of fun seeing those things from the car.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Seeing those things made me want to go sightseeing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still, I guess we don't have much time for that right now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, it's still fun to talk about what we saw out the car today and stuff!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In terms of an actual trip, we can go the next time we get a chance to!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well.
When we do go, we'll be able to have all the fun we couldn't today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, I was sort of surprised...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? By what?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought Shizuoka was really far away, but we went there and back in a day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean...
It did seem further away for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you've never driven before, those sorts of distances can be hard to judge.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll be driving in the future, so you'll have a better idea of it then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me? Driving...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't know if I'd be up to it...
I'd be too scared of crashing into things...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll become a safe driver after you practice at a driving school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How long have you had your license, Ken...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I got mine as soon as I could since I've always loved motorcycles...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The first time I went for a long ride on my motorcycle was so incredible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, traveling that far on my own felt like a huge accomplishment. It was like I'd taken a big step towards becoming an adult.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, you can all look forward to experiencing something similar in the future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's right. Having our own means of transport would mean getting to perform at even more live houses.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
We can even revisit all those places that gave us a chance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... And sharing a car would be much simpling than us all riding motorcycles...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally agree.
We could even take turns driving to make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, none of us are old enough to start getting our licenses yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Then, we should go get them together when we can someday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, great idea! I'd love to do that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Slow down, you two...
Keep in mind that there's a written test.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nah, Toya, what are you talking about?
We totally got this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They just ask you common-sense questions, right? It can't be that hard.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As someone who went through that process myself, I'm telling you that you need to study for it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it'd be so great if we could drive around and travel to really far off places together someday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We could go to Yokohama, Kyoto and... It'd almost be like a school trip.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We could do events all over, and even go camping together again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we've taken a pretty long break now. Let's get back to practicing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start again from the top while being mindful of what we discussed in the debrief.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'm all recharged and ready to go whenever!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! Let's give it one last good effort!
Street SEKAI
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...! This one's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is! I don't know which country this is supposed to be from, but I could spend an entire day walking around here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't forget that we need to head back once it's time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's interesting how SEKAI can grow by having a new area appear like this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I couldn't believe it when I found out what had happened.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm looking forward to exploring this area on my walks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That's what you're excited about?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, because of how many different countries are represented here. This means I'll get to travel to a new one every day! How amazing is that?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Traveling to different countries... Hehe. That does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I would've brought my camera with me if I'd known this area was going to appear...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I bet the pictures you take in these alleyways are going to look like works of art!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: However, as a result, she ended up struggling to find a compatible partner...

rows.Line: (She searched all over the place for a suitable partner, and she ended up choosing me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Plus, all the locals have started saying that they're glad she did.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I need to keep doing my best...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And show that I'm proud to be An's partner...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane

rows.Line: (I'm doing a little better compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But this still isn't enough...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (My heart...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's beating so fast.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm still nowhere near the level An reached that time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hey. Wait, Azusawa, are you practicing all on your own? You really are a hard worker.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Oh, also.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: That battle you had against Shiraishi. The way you two performed. It really shook us to the core.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you.

rows.Line: To be honest, I don't like the fact that I ended up losing to her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think it's good that I have another thing to feel frustrated about...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Another thing to feel frustrated about...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Frustration has the ability to help you move forward.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member A
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When we lost to Taiga that time, I was overcome with frustration...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's probably strange for me to say that since he's someone who performs all over the world. I know that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even so, I couldn't help but feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, this person who's been supporting us told me something.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That I'm frustrated because singing has become part of my identity.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And that what I'm feeling will help me move forward.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member B
rows.Line: It can help you move forward...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm frustrated about losing to An.
But I'm also glad I feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As An and I keep singing, I'm sure I'm going to be faced with more frustration and despair...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think I'll be driven to reach greater heights every time I feel those things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I want to keep growing and getting better with An moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I think that's why your singing hits us so hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: EVER Member B
rows.Line: We lost the will to continue after being completely clobbered by Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But you've been able to turn that experience into fuel.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You tossed aside any doubt or fear you felt, and embraced the frustration you felt. All in order to keep getting better...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You and your team really are something else. You guys are amazing performers, but your sheer will to continue chasing after your dream is beyond inspirational.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: You and Shiraishi really opened our eyes. We promise to stop holding you guys back!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I keep losing and finding myself chasing after all these different people. So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:

Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I've been practicing on my own as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line: You love singing more than anything.

rows.Line: More than anything...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna get back to practicing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Before I cool down too much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, let's resume!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Okay, we're ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to keep not being a normal student. I'm going to keep practicing and singing like there's no tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to keep taking everything I experience and channel it all into my music!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to propel myself forward and help make our dream come true!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here I go!
